Gei Jesus ga heeu, “Nnaganoho Moses ne gowadu gi goodou le e hai bolo aha?”
Digaula ga helekai, “Moses guu wanga di mogobuna gi taane e hai di beebaa haga maewae, gei taane la gaa mee di diiagi dono lodo.”
Jesus ga helekai gi digaula, “Moses ne hihi taganoho deenei, idimaa, goodou ala e aago ngadaa.
Mai taamada i di madagoaa nia mee ne hai, di Beebaa Dabu gu helekai boloo, ‘God ne hai taane mo di ahina.
Deenei tadinga taane gaa tanga gi daha mo dono damana mo dono dinana, gaa buni gi dono lodo.
Meemaa dogolua guu hai hua tuaidina e dahi.’ “Meemaa gu hagalee dogolua, guu dahi.
Di mee a God dela ne haga puni, gi hudee wwae ina go tangada.”
Di nadau ulu labelaa gi lodo di hale, gei ana dama agoago ga heeu gi Mee i di agoago deenei.
Mee ga helekai gi digaula, “Taane ga diiagi dono lodo, gaa lodo gi tuai ahina, mee guu hai di huaidu hai be di manu, gu hai baahi gi dono lodo donu.
E hai be di ahina ma ga diiagi dono lodo, gaa lodo gi tuai daane, mee guu hai di huaidu hai be di manu labelaa.”
Digau ne laha mai nadau damagiigi gi Jesus, bolo Mee gi hagadau dugu ina ono lima gi hongo digaula, gei ana dama agoago gaa wwou gi digaula.
Jesus ga iloo, gei Mee gu de hiihai, ga helekai gi ana dama agoago, “Heia nia damagiigi gi lloomoi gi di Au, hudee bule ina digaula, idimaa Teenua King o God la ni digau beenei.
Au e hagi adu gi goodou di tonu bolo tangada dela hagalee kae Teenua King o God be di hai o nia damagiigi, la deemee dana ulu i Teenua King o God.”
Gei mee ga dahi mai nia damagiigi gi lodo ono lima, ga hagadau dugu ono lima gi hongo digaula, ga haga maluagina digaula.
Di madagoaa Jesus e hana labelaa i hongo di ala, taane ga lele mai, ga dogoduli i ono mua, ga heeu gi Mee, “Tangada Agoago humalia, au e hai dagu aha, gei au ga hai mee gi di mouli dee odi?”
Jesus ga helekai, “Goe e aha dela e gahi Au bolo tangada agoago humalia? Deai tangada e humalia, dela hua go God modogoia.
Goe e iloo nia haganoho: ‘Hudee daaligidia tangada gii made, hudee hai be di manu, hudee gaiaa, hudee dilikai, hudee halahalau ina nia daangada, hagalabagau ina do damana mo do dinana.’”
Taane deelaa ga helekai, “Nia mee aanaa la guu hai huogodoo ko au mai i dogu mouli damagiigi.”
Jesus ga daumada adu a mee i dono aloho, ga helekai, “Di mee e dahi i golo digi heia kooe: Hana, huia o goloo gi daha, wanga ina nia bahi hadu gi digau hagaloale, gei goe gaa kae o maluagina i di langi. Nomuli, hanimoi, daudali mai Au.”
Taane deelaa ga longono eia, gei mee guu mmada hagadugina, guu hana manawa gee, idimaa, mee taane maluagina.
Jesus gaa mmada gi ana dama agoago, ga helekai gi digaula, “E haingadaa huoloo gi digau maluagina di ulu i Teenua King o God.”
Nia dama agoago a Maa gu gologolo gi ana helekai. Jesus ga helekai, “Agu dama, e haingadaa huoloo di ulu i Teenua King o God!
Tangada maluagina ma ga ulu i Teenua King o God le e koia e haingadaa i di manu ‘camel’ ma ga ulu laa lodo di bongoo di iwi dui mee.”
Gei nia dama agoago gu gologolo huoloo, ga leelee boloo, “Malaa, koai dela gaa mee di mouli?”
Jesus ga mmada adu gi digaula, ga helekai, “Di mee deenei e deemee i baahi tangada, gei e mee hua i baahi o God. Nia mee huogodoo e mee i baahi o God.”
Gei Peter ga helekai, “Mmada, gimaadou guu dugu madau mee huogodoo, gu daudali hua Goe.”
Jesus ga helekai, “Uaa, e donu, gei Au e hagi adu gi goodou bolo be koai ma ga diiagi dono hale, be ono duaahina daane mo ahina, be dono dinana be dono damana, be ana dama, be ana gowaa, i dogu gili mo di Longo Humalia,
mee gaa kae ana mee logowaahee i lodo di mouli deenei. Mee ga hai mee haga lau holongo gi nonua i ono hale, mono duaahina daane mo ahina, mono dinana, mono dama, mono gowaa, ge e kae di hagaduadua labelaa. Gei di madagoaa dela ma gaa dae mai, gei mee ga hai mee gi di mouli dee odi.
E dogologo digau ala i mugi mua dolomeenei, gaa hula laa muli, gei e dogologo digau ala i mugi muli dolomeenei, gaa hula laa mua.”
Jesus mo ana dama agoago e hula i hongo di ala gi Jerusalem, gei Jesus e hana i mua. Digaula e hula uli nadau gai, gei nia daangada ala e lloo adu i nadau muli le e mmaadagu. Gei Jesus ga haga dagabuli ana dama agoago gi mada ginaadou, ga hagi anga gi digaula nia mee ala gaa hai ang gi de Ia.
Ge Ia ga helekai, “Mmada, gidaadou e hula gi Jerusalem, dela di gowaa Tama Tangada gaa wanga gi nia lima o nia dagi aamua hai mee dabu, mo digau haga donudonu haganoho. Digaula ga haga balumee a Mee belee daaligi gii made, gaa wanga a Mee gi digau tuadimee.
Digaula gaa hai hagahuaidu a Mee mo di buibui nadau haawale gi Mee, ge e haga mamaawa a Mee, ga daaligi a Mee gii made, gei i muli nia laangi e dolu, ge Ia ga mouli aga.”
Gei James mo John, go nia dama daane a Zebedee, ga lloomoi gi Jesus, ga helekai, “Tangada Agoago, di mee i golo gimaua e hiihai bolo Goe gi heia mai gi gimaua.”
Jesus ga heeu gi meemaa, “Ma di aha dela e hiihai ginai goolua?”
Gei meemaa ga helekai anga, “Do madagoaa dela ma gaa noho i hongo do lohongo king, gimaua e hiihai bolo Goe gi haga noho ina gimaua i do baahi, e dahi i do baahi gau donu, ge e dahi i do baahi gau ihala.”
Gei Jesus ga helekai gi meemaa, “Goolua e de iloo di gulu mee dela e tangi ai. Goolua e mee di inu di ibu o di hagaduadua dela ga inu iei Au? Goolua e mee di babdais i di babdais dela ga babdais iei Au?”
Gei meemaa ga helekai, “Gimaua e mee.” Jesus ga helekai, “E donu bolo goolua ga inu di ibu dela ga inu iei Au, ge ga babdais i di babdais dela ga babdais iei Au.
Gei Au ogu donu ai e hili tangada e noho i dogu baahi gau donu mo gau ihala. Ma go God hua dela gaa wanga nia lohongo aanei gi ana gau ala gu hagatogomaalia ginai nia maa.”
Nia dama agoago dilongoholu ala i golo ne longono ginaadou di mee deenei, gu hagawelewele gi James mo John.
Gei Jesus ga haga dagabuli digaula, ga helekai, “Goodou e iloo bolo nia dagi o digau tuadimee le e mogobuna di dagi digau tuadimee. Gei nia dagi le e hai mee gi nia mogobuna dagi huogodoo.
Di hai deenei la hagalee go di godou hai dela e hai hegau ai. Tangada i godou baahi dela bolo ia gi aamua, geia gii hai tangada hai hegau ni goodou.
Tangada dela bolo ia gii hai tangada aamua, geia gii hai di hege ni digau huogodoo.
Tama Tangada hogi la hagalee ne hanimoi bolo nia daangada gi hai hegau ang gi de Ia, ge Ia ne haneia belee hai hegau gi digau huogodoo, gaa wanga dehuia dono mouli gi mouli ai digau dogologo.”
Digaula ne dau i Jericho. Di madagoaa Jesus mo ana dama agoago, mo tagabuli damana ga hagatanga gi daha mo di waahale deelaa, taane deegida dono ingoo go Bartimaeus, tama ni Timaeus, e noho i taalinga di ala e madamadau ana mee.
Dono longono hua bolo ma go Jesus o Nazareth, geia gaa wolo gi nua, “Jesus, tama a David, dumaalia mai gi di au!”
Digau dogologo guu wwou gi mee gi hudee leelee, geia koia ne wolo gi nonua, “Goe go Tama a David, Goe dumaalia mai gi di au!”
Gei Jesus gaa duu, ga helekai, “Goodou laha mai a mee gi di Au.” Gei digaula ga helekai gi taane deelaa, “Tenetene laa, duu i nua, Mee dela e gahigahi goe.”
Gei mee gaa hobo gi nua, gaa hudu gi daha dono gahu laa daha, gaa hana gi Jesus.
Gei Jesus ga heeu gi mee, “Ma di aha dela e hiihai ginai goe bolo Au gi heia adu gi di goe?” Gei taane deegida ga helekai, “Tangada Agoago, heia au gii mee di gidee labelaa.”
Gei Jesus ga helekai, “Hana. Ma go do hagadonu dela ne hagahumalia goe.” Di madagoaa hua deelaa, gei mee guu mee di mmada, ga daudali a Jesus i hongo di ala.
I di nadau lloo adu gi Jerusalem, hoohoo gi nia waahale Bethphage mo Bethany, digaula ne dau i di Gonduu Olib, gei Jesus ga hagau ana dama agoago dogolua gii hula gi mua,
ga helekai gi meemaa, “Hula gi di waahale dela i golo i gulu mua. Goolua ma gaa dau i golo, ga gidee tama ‘donkey’, digi hana tangada nonua, e daula i golo. Wwedee ina, dagia mai.
Maa tangada ga heeu boloo, ‘Goolua e hai di gulu aha?’ Gei goolua helekai boloo, ‘Tagi e hiihai e hai hegau ai di maa, ga laha mai laa hagalee duai.’”
Gei meemaa gaa hula, ga gidee di ‘donkey’ digi madua loo e daula i di ngudu di bontai di hale i taalinga di ala, gaa wwede di maa.
Hunu daangada i digaula nogo tuu i golo ga heeu gi meemaa, “Goolua e wwede di ‘donkey’ eimaha?”
Gei meemaa ga helekai nia helekai a Jesus ne hai, gei nia daane aalaa ga dumaalia gi meemaa gii hula ginaadou.
Gei meemaa gaa dagi tama ‘donkey’ gi Jesus, gaa gahu di manu gi di gahu, gei Jesus gaa gaga gi hongo di maa.
Digau dogologo gaa holo nadau gahu gi hongo di ala, gei hunu daangada e duuduu mai nadau manga laagau, e magamaga laa hongo di ala, e haaligi di ala.
Digau ala e hula i mua mono gau ala e dagi mai muli, ga momoogo, “Hagaamuina a God, God gi hagahumalia ina tangada dela e hanimoi i di ingoo o Dimaadua.
God gi hagahumalia ina tenua o tadau damana go David dela ga dau mai. Hagaamuina a God!”
Jesus ga ulu gi lodo Jerusalem, gaa hana gi lodo di Hale Daumaha, ga madamada gi nia mee huogodoo ala i lodo. Ga hiahi ia di mee, gei Mee gaa hana gi daha mo di gowaa deelaa, gaa hana gi Bethany mo ana dama agoago dilongoholu maa lua.
Dono daiaa, gei digaula ga hagatanga labelaa i Bethany, gei Jesus gu hiigai.
Gei Mee ga gidee di laagau ‘fig’ haga mogowaa, e dau logo ono lau, ga hanadu ginai belee mmada be Ia e gida ana golee i di maa. Gei dono dau adu, nia lau hua ala i golo, idimaa, ma hagalee di madagoaa e huwa ai nia ‘fig’.
Jesus ga helekai gi di laagau ‘fig’, “Tangada e gai labelaa dana golee mai i di goe ai.” Gei ana dama agoago gu longono ginaadou a Mee.
I di nadau dau adu hua gi Jerusalem, gei Jesus gaa hana gi lodo di Hale Daumaha, ga hagabagi digau huogodoo ala e huihui mo di huihui gi daha nadau mee. Mee ga hulihuli gi lala nia deebele digau wawaaheei bahihadu, mo nia lohongo o digau huihui mwuroi.
Gei Mee gu hagalee dumaalia gi tei dangada gi dagidagia ana mee i lodo di Hale Daumaha.
Mee ga agoago gi digaula, “Ma guu hihi i lodo di Beebaa Dabu bolo God gu helekai, ‘Dogu Hale Daumaha le e haga ingoo bolo di hale hai dalodalo ni digau henuailala huogodoo.’ “Gei goodou guu hai di maa di lohongo hai gaiaa!”
Nia dagi hai mee dabu, mono gau haga donudonu haganoho ga longono ginaadou nnelekai aanei, gei digaula ga daamada ga halahala di nadau hai belee daaligi a Jesus. Gei digaula e mmaadagu, idimaa, nia daangada dogologo e hagalabagau huoloo nia agoago a Maa.
Ga hiahi ia di mee, Jesus mo ana dama agoago ga hagatanga gi daha mo di waahale.
Hagaluada loo dono daiaa, i di nadau hula i hongo di ala, ga gidee di laagau ‘fig’ deelaa, la guu mae aga i lala.
Peter ga langahia ga helekai gi Jesus, “Tangada Agoago, mmada gi di laagau dela ne haga halauwa Kooe, guu mae!”
Jesus ga helekai, “Hagadonu ina a God.
Au e hagi adu gii donu goodou bolo tangada ma ga helekai gi di gonduu deenei boloo, ‘Hana, doo gi lodo di moana,’ geia hagalee manawa logo, e haga donu hua bolo ma gaa hai hua be ana helekai, gei di maa gaa gila.
Deenei laa, Au e hagi adu bolo goodou ma ga dalodalo e madau di godou mee, hagadonu ina bolo goodou ga hai mee gi di mee dela e madau ai, gei di maa ga dugu adu gi goodou.
Malaa, goodou ma gaa tuu ga dalodalo, dumaalia gi nia hala o tangada ne hai adu. Gei di godou Damana i di langi ga dumaalia adu gi godou ihala.
[Maa goodou hagalee dumaalia gi nia hala digau ala i golo, di godou Damana dela i di langi hagalee dumaalia gi godou ihala.”]
Digaula gaa dau adu labelaa gi Jerusalem. Di madagoaa hua o Jesus e hanadu gi lodo di Hale Daumaha, gei nia dagi aamua hai mee dabu, mo digau haga donudonu haganoho, mo nia dagi mmaadua ga lloomoi,
ga heeu, “Ma di mogobuna dagi mai hee dela e hai ai au mee aanei? Ma koai ne dugu adu di mogobuna deenei?”
Jesus ga helekai, “Au gaa hai dagu heeu hua e dahi, maa goodou ga hagi mai, gei Au ga hagi adu di mogobuna dagi ni ooi dela e hai ai agu mee aanei:
Hagia mai, di mogobuna a John dela e hai ana babdais, la mai baahi o God, be mai baahi nia daangada?”
Digaula ga daamada ga lagamaaloo i nadau mehanga boloo, “Gidaadou la ga helekai bolo aha? Maa gidaadou ga helekai, ‘Mai baahi o God’, gei Mee ga helekai, ‘Malaa e aha goodou hagalee hagadonu a John?’
Maa gidaadou ga helekai boloo, ‘Mai hua nia daangada...’” (Digaula e mmaadagu i nia daangada, idimaa, e dogologo e hagadonu bolo John la di soukohp e donu.)
Malaa, digaula ga helekai gi Jesus, “Gimaadou e de iloo.” Jesus ga helekai gi digaula, “Au hogi hagalee hagi adu di mogobuna mai hee dela e hai ai agu mee aanei.”
Jesus ga agoago i nia ala kai, “Tangada gaa dogi dana hadagee waini, ga abaaba, gaa hai dana gowaa tau waini, ga haga duu dana angulaa hagaloohi. Mee gaa wanga gi ana gau dogi mee gi ngalua ai, gaa hana haga mogowaa.
Di madagoaa taugai, gei mee ga hagau dana dangada hai hegau gi digau dogi mee aalaa, gi gaamai dono duhongo i di hadagee waini deelaa.
Gei digau dogi mee gaa kumi tangada hai hegau deelaa, ga daaligi, ga hagau gii hana, dana mee ne kae ai.
Gei tangada dana hadagee waini ga hagau labelaa dana huai dangada hai hegau. Digau dogi mee ga hagamaawa di libogo o maa, gaa hai di nadau hai e haga langaadia a mee.
Gei tangada dana hadagee ga hagau labelaa dana huai dangada, gei digaula ga daaligi a mee. E dogologo ne hagau nomuli, gei guu tale huogodoo gi di haingadaa deelaa, hunu gau gu hagamamaawa, ge hunu gau gu daaligi gii mmade.
Tangada dela ne dubu i golo, la go tama daane donu o tangada dana hadagee waini. Muliagi loo gei mee ga hagau hua go dana dama daane donu gi digau dogi mee aalaa. Ga helekai, ‘Au e iloo bolo digaula ga hagalabagau laa dagu dama daane.’
Gei digau dogi mee aalaa ga leelee i nadau mehanga boloo, ‘Deenei la go tama donu a maa. Lloomoi, gidaadou ga daaligi a mee gii made, gei gidaadou ga hai mee gi nia mee a maa ala belee hai mee ginai.’
Malaa, digaula gaa kumi tama daane deelaa, ga daaligi, gaa hudu tuaidina o maa gi daha mo di hadagee waini.”
Jesus ga heeu, “Malaa, tangada dana hadagee waini la gaa hai dana aha? Mee ga hanimoi, ga dadaaligi nia daane aalaa, gaa wanga di hadagee waini gi nnuai daangada gi benabena ina.
Goodou digi daulia di Beebaa Dabu dela e helekai boloo, ‘Di hadu dela ne hudu gi daha go digau hau hale bolo di balu hadu, la guu hai di hadu dela e kaedahi e hagalabagau.
Di mee deenei la ne hai go Dimaadua, e haga goboina dangada.’”
Nia dagi o digau o Jew, gu hagamada belee lawalawa a Jesus, i digaula e iloo bolo di ala kai a Maa le e hagatau ang gi ginaadou. I di nadau mmaadagu i digau dogologo aalaa, ga diiagi a Mee, gaa hula.
Nia Pharisee mo digau hagamaamaa Herod ne hagau gi Jesus, belee haga ihala a mee gi nia heeu.
Digaula ga lloomoi gi Mee ga heeu, “Tangada Agoago, gimaadou e iloo bolo Goe e helekai donu, e haga balumee nia hagabaubau dangada, ge hagalee hilihili dangada, ge e agoago di tonu i di hiihai a God gi nia daangada. Hagia mai be di maa e hai baahi gi tadau haganoho di hui tadau dagitedi gi di king o Rome? Gidaadou e hui be deeai?”
Gei Jesus gu gidee i lodo nadau helekai halahalau, ga helekai, “Goodou belee haga ihala au eiaha? Gaamai teenedi silber gii mmada au.”
Digaula gaa wanga di nadau teenedi, gei Mee ga heeu, “Ma di ada ni ooi, ge di ingoo ni ooi aanei?” Gei digaula ga helekai, “Ni di king o Rome.”
Gei Jesus ga helekai, “Malaa, wanga ina gi di king nia mee a di king, ge wanga ina gi God nia mee a God.” Gei digaula gu goboina e ginaadou a Jesus.
Nia Sadduccee, ala e agoago bolo nia daangada e hagalee mouli aga i di made, ga lloomoi gi Jesus ga heeu,
“Tangada Agoago, Moses guu hihi taganoho deenei, ‘Taane ma gaa made, gei dono lodo gaa noho i golo, dana dama ai, gei tuaahina daane o taane dela ne made gaa lodo gi di ahina deelaa, gi gila mai di tama e ala be di tama ni taane dela ne made.’
“Dolomaa, tagahaanau daane dogohidu, di ulu madua gaa hai dono lodo, nomuli gaa made, di nau dama ai.
Gei togolua daane la gaa lodo labelaa gi di ahina deelaa, geia gaa made labelaa, di nau dama ai, gei togodolu daane la go di hai la hua.
Taga haanau daane dogohidu aalaa guu lodo huogodoo gi di ahina deelaa, gei ginaadou guu mmade huogodoo, nadau dama ai. Muliagina loo gei di ahina la gaa made.
Di madagoaa digau mmade ma ga mouli aga i di laangi o di mouli aga, di ahina deelaa la gaa hai di lodo ni ooi? Idimaa, digau dogohidu aalaa ne lodo huogodoo gi mee.”
Jesus ga helekai, “Goodou gu ihala, idimaa goodou e de iloo nia helekai o di Beebaa Dabu mo di mogobuna o God.
Digau mmade ma ga mouli aga, la hagalee hai nadau lodo, gadoo be digau di langi.
Deenei di agoago o di mouli aga i di made: goodou digi daulia di Beebaa Moses di kai o di laagau e ulaula? Ma guu hihi bolo God e helekai gi Moses boloo, ‘Au go di God o Abraham, di God o Isaac, mo di God o Jacob.’
“Mee go di God o digau mouli, hagalee ni digau mmade. Goodou digau gu ihala!”
Tangada haga donudonu haganoho i golo, e hagalongo gi nia helekai aanei. Mee gu iloo bolo nia helekai a Jesus ala ne hai gi di heeu o nia Sadduccee, le e humalia. Geia ga hanimoi gi Jesus, ga heeu, “Dehee taganoho koia e hagalabagau i nia haganoho huogodoo?”
Gei Jesus ga helekai, “Deenei taganoho koia e aamua: ‘Israel, gi hagalongo! Dimaadua dela go tadau God, go Mee hua dela go God.
Goe gi aloho i Dimaadua, go doo God, aga i lodo do manawa hagatau, mo do hagataalunga hagatau, mo au hagabaubau huogodoo, mo oo mahi huogodoo.’
“Gei di lua haganoho le e hai hua be di maa, boloo, ‘Goe gi aloho i tangada dela i do baahi, gii hai be do aloho i di goe.’ “E deai taganoho labelaa i golo, e aamua laa hongo nia haganoho e lua aanei ai.”
Tangada haga donudonu haganoho ga helekai gi Jesus, “Tangada Agoago, gu hai donu go au helekai ala ne hai boloo: ‘Tagi la dela hua go God, deai di god labelaa i golo ai, dela hua go Mee.
Tangada la gi aloho i dono God, mai i lodo dono manawa, mo ana hagabaubau mo ono mahi, gei gi aloho i tangada dela i dono baahi be dono aloho i deia.’ Koia e hagalabagau go di hai hegau gi nia haganoho e lua aanei, i tadau hai dela e wanga dehuia tadau manu gi hongo di gowaa dudu tigidaumaha, mono tigidaumaha huogodoo ala e hai ang gi God.”
Jesus ga iloo Ia, bolo nia helekai a maa gu hai donu, ge Ia ga helekai gi mee, “Goe hagalee mogowaa i Teenua King o God.” Gei nomuli, gu deai tangada e heeu dana mee gi Mee ai.
Di madagoaa Jesus e hai ana agoago i lodo di Hale Daumaha, ge Ia ga heeu, “Digau haga donudonu haganoho le e aha ala e hai bolo di Mesaia la di hagadili ni David?
Idimaa, di Hagataalunga Dabu gu haga helekai a David: ‘Dimaadua gu helekai gi dogu Dagi: Goe noho i dogu baahi gau donu, gaa dae loo gi dogu madagoaa ma gaa dugu o hagadaumee gi lala o babaawae.’
“David donu e gahi a mee bolo dono Dagi, malaa di Mesaia la di hagadili behee ni David?” Nia daangada dogologo nogo hagalongo tenetene gi nia agoago a Jesus.
Mee ga agoago gi digaula, “Goodou hudee kawe i digau haga donudonu haganoho ala e ulu i nia gahu lloo, ga heehee laa, gei e hiihai bolo nia daangada gi hagaaloho mo hagalaamua ina ginaadou i lodo nia gowaa huihui mee,
ge e hilihili nadau lohongo aamua i lodo nia synagogee mo lodo nia hagamiami.
Aanei go digaula ala e mada maaloo e kae nia goloo o nia hale nia ahina guu mmade nadau lodo, ge e hai nadau dalodalo lloowehaa i mua nia golomada o nia daangada. Malaa, nadau hagaduadua la koia e huaidu.”
Jesus e noho i lodo di Hale Daumaha, hoohoo gi di gowaa dela e dugu ginai nia tigidaumaha, ge Ia e daumada digau ala e dugu nadau teenedi. E dogologo digau maluagina e tigidaumaha nadau teenedi e logo.
Di ahina hagaloale guu made dono lodo ga hanimoi nomuli, gaa dugu ana teenedi e lua.
Gei Jesus ga gahi mai ana dama agoago gi dono baahi, ga helekai, “Au e hagi adu gi goodou di tonu bolo tigidaumaha di ahina hagaloale deenei ne hai, la koia gu damanaiee i nia tigidaumaha digaula huogodoo.
Digau ala i golo ne dugu hunu teenedi gi lodo di gowaa tigidaumaha mai nadau maluagina, gei di ahina hagaloale deenei gu hagaodi anga ana teenedi huogodoo ala belee hagahumalia ieia.”
Di madagoaa Jesus ne hagatanga i di Hale Daumaha, tangada i ana dama agoago ga helekai, “Tangada Agoago, mmada gi nia hadu mono hale ala e humalia!”
Jesus ga helekai anga, “Goe e gidee nia hale humalia aanei? Di hadu e dahi gaa dubu i dono lohongo ai. Nia hadu huogodoo ga meheu gi lala.”
Jesus nogo noho i hongo di Gonduu Olib, i di baahi adu gi di Hale Daumaha, gei Peter, James, John mo Andrew ga mmaanege adu gi baahi o Mee, ga heeu gi Mee mada ginaadou,
“Meenei, hagia mai be nia mee aanei le e hai ma gaa hee, ge hagailongo gi di aha, bolo ma gu hoohoo gaa hai?”
Jesus ga helekai, “Goodou pula i goodou, gi de halahalau hua go tangada.
Idimaa, dogologo e lloomoi i dogu ingoo, ga hagi adu, ‘Au go mee!’ Gei nia daangada dogologo ga halahalau go digaula.
Di madagoaa goodou ma ga longono nia lee dauwa ala e hai hoohoo mai mono longo dauwa ala e mogowaa, goodou hudee uli godou gai. Nia mee aanei le e hai loo gii kila, gei hagalee haga modongoohia bolo di hagaodi gu dau mai.
Nia henua ga heheebagi, nia king ga heheebagi, nia madagowaa huogodoo i henuailala ga ngalungalua, nia dau hiigai ga i golo. Nia mee aanei le e hai gadoo be di mmae matagidagi o di ahina ma ga haanau.
“Goodou gii noho kanakana, idimaa, goodou ga lawalawa go nia daangada gaa lahi gi di gowaa hai gabunga. Goodou ga haga mamaawa i lodo nia synagogee gaa lahi gi mua nia king i dogu gili, bolo goodou gi haga modongoohia ina gi digaula di hai o di Longo Humalia.
I mua di hagaodi ga dau mai, di Longo Humalia e hai gii dele gii dau gi nia henua huogodoo.
Malaa, goodou ma ga lawalawa, gaa lahi gi di gowaa hai gabunga, gei goodou hudee maanadu e logo be goodou ga helekai bolo aha i mua digaula. Goodou helekai hua nia mee ala ga gowadu gi goodou i di madagoaa deelaa. Idimaa, nia helekai ala ga helekai ai goodou, la hagalee mai godou baahi, nia helekai mai baahi di Hagataalunga Dabu.
Nia daane gaa wanga nadau duaahina daane gi daaligidia gii mmade. Nia damana hogi gaa wanga nadau dama gi daaligidia gii mmade, gei nia dama ga hai baahi gi nadau maadua, gaa wanga digaula gi daaligidia gii mmade.
Digau huogodoo ga de hiihai adu gi goodou i dogu gili. Be koai hua dela e dadaahi dono hagadonu gaa dae loo gi di hagaodi ga mouli.
“Goodou ga gidee di ada mee haga manawa gee dangada e duu i lodo di gowaa e dee duudanga belee duu ai.” (Tangada dela e dau di haga iloo deenei, la gi iloo ia tadinga o di maa!) “Di madagoaa hua deelaa, digau ala e noho i Judea la gii llele gi daha gi tomo nia dama gonduu.
Tangada dela i tomo dono hale, la hudee hai bolo ia e haneia gi lala e ulu gi lodo dono hale e kae ana mee.
Tangada dela i lodo henua, la hudee haneia bolo e kae dono gahu.
Koia e huaidu ang gi nia ahina hai dama, mo nia ahina nadau dama lligi i nia laangi aalaa ma ga dau mai!
Goodou dalodalo bolo nia mee aanei gi hudee heia adu i di madagoaa magalillili!
Idimaa, nia haingadaa o nia laangi aalaa, la koia e huaidu huoloo i nia haingadaa mai taamada di madagoaa ne hai henuailala go God, gaa dae mai loo gi dolomeenei. Nia huaidu beenei e kila aga labelaa maalia ai.
Malaa, Dimaadua e haga hogoohi nia laangi aalaa; maa Mee ga hagalee hai beelaa, deai tangada e mouli ai. Mee e haga hogoohi mai nia laangi aalaa, ne hidi mai i ana dama ala ne hilihili.
“Tangada ma ga helekai adu gi goodou, boloo, ‘Deenei di Mesaia!’ be, ‘Deelaa a Mee!’ goodou hudee hagadonu ina a mee.
Idimaa, nia mesaia dilikai mono soukohp dilikai ga kila aga i golo. Digaula gaa hai nadau hagailongo haga goboina mono mogobuna, belee halahalau nia dama a God ala gu hilihili, be di maa e mee.
Gii pula i goodou. Au e hagi adu nia mee aanei huogodoo i mua di madagoaa.
“Nia laangi ala i muli di haingadaa damana, di laa la ga bouli, gei di malama ga hagalee maahina.
Nia heduu o di langi ga monnono, gei nia mogobuna o di ahiaalangi ga ngalungalua gi daha mo nadau lohongo.
Gei goodou gaa mmada gi Tama Tangada e haneia i lodo nia gololangi, i nia mahi mono madamada aamua.
Gei Mee ga hagau ana gau di langi gi nia mada e haa o henuailala, belee haga dagabuli mai digau a God ala gu hilihili, e loomoi i nia mada huogodoo o henuailala.
“Goodou gaabee di mee deenei e hagatau gi di laagau ‘fig’. Nia manga o di maa ala ma ga matilitili, gaa tomo ono lau, goodou gu iloo bolo di madagoaa mahanahana la gu hoohoo mai.
E hai gadoo beelaa, be goodou ala ma ga gidee nia mee aanei ala ma ga kila aga, gei goodou gu iloo hua, bolo di madagoaa gu hoohoo mai, gu togomaalia ga daamada.
Gi langahia bolo nia mee aanei le e kila, e hai i mua di adu dangada dela e mouli dolomeenei ma gaa mmade huogodoo.
Di langi mo henuailala le e odi, gei agu helekai la hagalee e odi.
“Deai tangada e iloo di laangi deelaa be di aawaa ai; digau di langi e de iloo hogi, mo Tama daane hogi e de iloo Ia labelaa, dela hua go Tamana modogoia e iloo.
Noho kanakana, i goodou e de iloo di dae mai di madagoaa.
E hai gadoo be taane ma gaa hai dono ala e hana haga mogowaa, gaa dugu ana gau hai hegau belee benebene dono hale, gaa wanga nadau moomee e hai. Geia ga helekai gi di hagaloohi o di bontai, bolo gii noho hilahila gi daha.
Malaa, goodou gii noho kanakana, i di hanimoi o tagi di hale la de iloo goodou, be ma hiahi, be i di waelua di boo, be i mua di ada, be i mua di laa e hobo.
Maa mee ga limalima dono hanimoi, mee gi de boogia hua goodou e kii.
Agu helekai adu gi goodou, le e helekai gi digau huogodoo, bolo goodou gii noho kanakana.”
Nia laangi e lua i mua Tagamiami Pasoobaa mo Tagamiami Palaawaa Digi Hagatanga, nia dagi aamua hai mee dabu, mo digau haga donudonu haganoho e halahala di nadau ala hagammuni e kumi a Jesus e daaligi gii made.
Digaula ga helekai, “Gidaadou hagalee hai di mee deenei i lodo di laangi Pasoobaa, gi dee wwaa hua nia daangada.”
Jesus nogo i Bethany i di hale o Simon, taane nogo magi genegene i mua. Di madagoaa hua a Jesus e miami, gei di ahina ga hanimoi mo dana loaabi ‘alabaster’ e honu lolo kala hui ngadaa ne hai gi nia ‘nard’, gaa huge, ga hagatulutulu di libogo o Jesus.
Digau ala nogo i golo la gu hagawelewele, ga helekai i nadau mehanga, “Ma e aha dela gu hagauwwou di lolo kala deenei?
Maa bolo ne hui gi daha e mee hua di kila mai nia silber i hongo dolu lau, gaa wanga gi digau hagaloale!” Gei digaula ga helekai tamu i di ahina deelaa.
Gei Jesus ga helekai, “Diagia hua a mee. Goodou e haga madugidugia a mee eiaha? E humalia ge madamada go dana hai dela ne hai mai gi di Au.
Digau hagaloale le e noho i godou baahi i nia madagoaa huogodoo, e mee hua di godou hagamaamaa i di ingoo hua di madagoaa dela e hiihai ginai goodou. Gei Au e hagalee waalooloo i godou baahi.
Gei di ahina deenei ne hai go dana mee dela e mee. Mee ne hagatulutulu dana lolo kala gi dogu huaidina, belee hagatogomaalia Au i mua dogu danu.
Au e hagi adu gii donu goodou bolo nia gowaa huogodoo i henuailala hagatau ala e dele ginai di Longo Humalia, dana mee dela ne hai, le e dele hogi, e haga langalangahia a mee.”
Judas Iscariot, tangada i nia dama agoago dilongoholu maa lua, gaa hana gi nia dagi aamua hai mee dabu, belee odi a Jesus gi digaula.
Digaula gu tenetene huoloo gi telekai a Judas dela ne hai ang gi ginaadou, ga hagababa bolo ginaadou e wanga nadau teenedi gi mee. Malaa, Judas ga daamada ga halahala dana madagoaa humalia belee wanga a Jesus gi digaula.
Di laangi matagidagi o nia laangi llauehe o Tagamiami Palaawaa Digi Hagatanga, dela go di laangi e daaligi ai nia siibi o Tagamiami Pasoobaa, gei nia dama agoago a Jesus ga heeu gi Mee, “Dehee dau gowaa e hiihai gimaadou gi hagatogomaalia ina dau Hagamiami Pasoobaa?”
Jesus ga hagau ana dama agoago dogolua, ga helekai, “Hula gi di waahale damana deelaa, taane i golo ga heetugi adu, e kae dana mee hagahau wai, daudalia a mee.
Gei goolua ga helekai gi tangada donu di hale dela ga ulu ginai mee, boloo, ‘Tangada Agoago e helekai bolo dehee di ruum e humalia ang gi de Ia mo ana dama agoago, e hai di nadau Hagamiami Pasoobaa?’
Gei mee ga hagi adu dana ruum damana i nua, gu togomaalia. Deelaa di gowaa e hagatogomaalia gulu mee mai gi gidaadou.”
Nia dama agoago a Maa gaa hula gi di waahale damana, ga gidee nia mee huogodoo e hai be nnelekai a Jesus, gei meemaa ga hagatogomaalia Tagamiami Pasoobaa.
Hiahi ia di mee, Jesus mo ana dama agoago dilongoholu maa lua gaa hula gi Jerusalem.
Di nadau noho miami, gei Jesus ga helekai, “Au e hagi adu gi goodou bolo tangada e dahi i goodou la gaa wanga Au, mee e miami dalia Au dolomeenei.”
Gei nia dama agoago gu de nnoomaalia gi telekai deelaa, ga hagadau dagidahi, e hai nadau heeu gi Mee boloo, “Meenei, ma ko au dela e helekai iei Goe?”
Gei Jesus ga helekai, “Tangada e dahi i goodou dilongoholu maa lua dela gaa hagatiu dana palaawaa gi lodo di ibu dalia Au, deelaa go mee.
Tama Tangada le e made be nnelekai di Beebaa Dabu. Gei e huaidu huoloo ang gi tangada dela ma ga hagi anga Tama Tangada. E humalia hua maa tangada deelaa hagalee belee haanau!”
I di nadau miami hua, gei Jesus ga dahi aga dana palaawaa, ga danggee, ga ginigini, gaa duwwe gi ana dama agoago, ga helekai, “Geina, deenei la go dogu huaidina.”
Nomuli ga dahi aga dana ibu waini, ga danggee ang gi God, gaa wanga gi digaula, huogodoo gu inu di maa.
Jesus ga helekai, “Aanei la go ogu dodo ala e hali gi digau dogologo. Ogu dodo la di hagababa hoou a God.
Au e hagi adu gi goodou bolo Au hagalee e inu di ibu waini deenei labelaa, gaa dae loo gi di laangi Au ma ga inu nia waini hoou i Teenua King o God.”
Nomuli hua di nadau daahili, digaula gaa hula gi di Gonduu Olib.
Jesus ga helekai gi digaula, “Goodou huogodoo gaa llele dagidahi, ga diiagi Au, i di Beebaa Dabu e helekai boloo, ‘God ga daaligi tangada hagaloohi siibi, gei nia siibi la ga lellele dagidahi.’
“Gei i muli dogu mouli aga, gei Au gaa hana i godou mua gi Galilee.”
Peter ga helekai gi Mee, “Ma e aha maa digaula ga diiagi Goe, gei au la hagalee loo e diiagi Goe!”
Jesus ga helekai gi Peter, “Au e hagi adu bolo i mua teduu daane ma gaa wolo haga lua boo nei, gei goe ga helekai haga dolu bolo goe e de iloo e goe Au.”
Peter ga helekai maaloo, “Au hagalee loo e helekai bolo au e de iloo eau Goe, ma e aha maa au e hai gii made dalia Goe!” Nia dama agoago huogodoo ala i golo e helekai go telekai la hua.
Digaula gaa dau i Gethsemane, gei Jesus ga helekai gi ana dama agoago, “Noho i ginei i dogu madagoaa e hai agu dalodalo.”
Mee gaa lahi a Peter, James mo John. Di manawa gee guu dau hogi i ono lodo,
ge Ia ga helekai gi digaula, “Ogu lodo gu manawa gee huoloo, be di mee ga hagahuaidu Au gii made. Goodou noho i ginei mo di madamada gi daha.”
Gei Mee gaa hana gi mada tanga i digaula, gaa bala ia gi hongo di gelegele, ga dalodalo be di madagoaa o di hagaduadua le e mee di daa gi daha mo Ia, be di maa e mee.
Mee ga helekai, “Abba, dogu Damana, Goe e mee i nia mee huogodoo. Daawa ina di ibu o di hagaduadua gi daha mo Au. Gei hagalee go dogu hiihai, go do hiihai le e hai.”
Gei Mee ga hanimoi gi baahi ana dama agoago dogodolu, ga gidee digaula e kii. Gei Mee ga helekai gi Peter, “Simon, goe e kii hua? Goe e deemee di haga aala i di aawaa hua e dahi?”
Mee ga helekai gi digaula, “Noho loloohi, dalodalo gi dee too goodou gi lodo di hagamada. Di hagataalunga le e hiihai, gei tuaidina le e bagege.”
Gei Mee gaa hana labelaa, ga dalodalo, go nnelekai la hua nogo dalodalo ai i mua.
Ga hanimoi labelaa gi nia dama agoago, gei digaula guu kii, gu deemee di haga aala. Digaula gu de iloo di nadau helekai gi Mee.
Tolu holongo ne hanimoi iei Mee gi digaula, ga helekai, “Goodou e kii hua molooloo? Guu dohu di godou molooloo! Di aawaa la gu dau mai! Mmada, Tama Tangada la gaa wanga gi lodo nia lima digau huaidu.
Goodou tuu i nua, hula. Mmada, tangada dela e wanga Au, la deenei gu hanimoi!”
Jesus nogo leelee hua igolo, gei Judas, tangada i nia dama agoago dilongoholu maa lua a Maa, gu dau mai mo digau dogologo mo nadau hulumanu dauwa mono goloo heebagi. Digaula ne hagau mai go nia dagi hai mee dabu mo digau haga donudonu haganoho mo nia dagi mmaadua.
Tangada dela e hagi aga a Mee gu haga modongoohia gi tagabuulinga dangada deelaa, “Taane dela gaa hongi ko au, deelaa go Mee. Lawalawa ina, lahia, hagaloohia gi humalia.”
Di dau mai hua Judas, mee ga hanadu gi Jesus, ga helekai, “Tangada Agoago”, ga hongi adu a Mee.
Gei digaula ga lawalawa a Jesus gi mau dangihi.
Tangada i digau ala e tuu i golo ga haga mmuu dana hulumanu dauwa, gaa tuu talinga di hege a tagi aamua hai mee dabu.
Jesus ga helekai, “Goodou e aha, ala e lloomoi mo godou goloo heebagi belee lawalawa Au, guu hai Au be tangada gu ihala?
Nia laangi huogodoo, gei Au nogo agoago i lodo di Hale Daumaha, goodou nogo i golo, digi kumidia Au. Gei nnelekai di Beebaa Dabu le e hai gi kila aga.”
Nomuli, gei ana dama agoago huogodoo ga diiagi a Mee, gaa llele gi daha.
Tama daane e ulu hua di gahu malali, nogo daudali a Jesus, gei digaula belee lawalawa a mee,
gei mee gaa lele, gu diiagi ono goloo nogo ulu ai.
Digaula gaa lahi a Jesus gi di hale o tagi aamua hai mee dabu, di gowaa e dagabuli nia dagi aamua hai mee dabu huogodoo, nia dagi mmaadua, mo digau haga donudonu haganoho.
Peter e daudali a Jesus haga mogowaa, ga dau loo gi lodo di abaaba o di hale o tagi aamua hai mee dabu. Geia gaa noho gi lala i baahi digau hagaloohi e haga mahanahana.
Nia dagi hai mee dabu, mo digau hai gabunga aamua e hagamahi e halahala nadau hagamodongoohia hai baahi belee daaligi Jesus gii made, gei e deemee di gida di nadau mee.
E dogologo digau haga modongoohia dilikai e hagahuaidu a Jesus, gei nia haga modongoohia digaula hagalee buni.
Gei hunu daane ga tuu i nua, ga helekai tilikai e hagahuaidu a Jesus,
“Gimaadou gu hagalongo gi Mee e helekai boloo, ‘Au ga oho di Hale Daumaha dela ne hau go nia daangada, gei i muli hua nia laangi e dolu, gei Au ga haga duu aga di maa, hagalee e hau go nia daangada.’”
Gei digaula hogi hagalee buni gi di kai e dahi.
Tagi aamua hai mee dabu ga duu i nua i mua digaula huogodoo, ga heeu gi Jesus, “Au helekai i golo ai gi nia hagahuaidu digaula ala e hai adu?”
Gei Jesus e noho hua dee muu. Tagi aamua hai mee dabu ga heeu labelaa, “Goe go di Mesaia, Tama daane a God Aamua?”
Jesus ga helekai, “Ko Au go Mee. Goodou huogodoo gaa mmada laa gi Tama Tangada gaa noho i di baahi gau donu o God Mogobuna, ga hanimoi i hongo nia gololangi.”
Tagi aamua hai mee dabu ga duu i nua, ga haahi dono gahu ga helekai, “Gidaadou hagalee halahala tadau gau haga modongoohia!
Goodou gu longono nia hagahuaidu a maa. Dehee di godou hiihai?” Gei digaula ga helekai hai baahi, “Mee guu doo gi di hala, gu humalia hua dono hagamaehamaeha.”
Hunu gau i digaula e buibui nadau haawale gi Mee, gaa gahu nia golomada o maa, ga hagamamaawa a Mee, ga helekai, “Ma koai dela ne hagamaawa goe?” Gei digau hagaloohi gaa lahi a mee mo di paapaa.
Peter nogo i lodo di abaaba, gei di ahina hai hegau a tagi aamua hai mee dabu ga hanimoi laa dono baahi.
Di madagoaa di ahina ne gidee a Peter e haga mahanahana, geia gaa mmada haga huudonu gi mee, ga helekai, “Kooe nogo madalia labelaa a Jesus o Nazareth.”
Peter ga haga de iloo ia ga helekai, “Au e de iloo di mee dela e helekai iei goe,” gei mee ga hanadu gi di bontai, [gei teduu gaa wolo.]
Tama ahina gaa mmada gi mee i golo, ga helekai labelaa gi digaula, “Mee tangada i digaula.”
Gei Peter ga haga de iloo labelaa. Nomuli hua, gei digau ala nogo tuu i golo ga helekai, “Goe e deemee di hagammuni goe, i di goe tangada i digaula, tangada mai Galilee.”
Gei Peter ga helekai, “Au e helekai i di tonu bolo God gi hagahuaidu ina au, be au e helekai tilikai. Au e de iloo eau Taane dela e helekai iei goodou!”
Nomuli hua, gei teduu gaa wolo i di lua wolo, gei Peter ga langahia nia helekai a Jesus ne hai, “I mua teduu gaa wolo haga lua, gei goe ga helekai haga dolu bolo goe e de iloo e goe Au.” Nomuli hua, gei mee gu lodo huaidu huoloo, gu dangidangi manawa gee.
Luada loo, gei tagi aamua hai mee dabu gu limalima di heetugi gi nia dagi mmaadua, digau haga donudonu haganoho, digau hai gabunga aamua huogodoo, ga haga taele di nadau hai. Digaula ga lawalawa a Jesus gi tiini baalanga, gaa lahi gi Pilate.
Gei Pilate ga heeu gi mee, “Ma Kooe dela go di king o digau o Jew?” Gei Jesus ga helekai, “Dela gu helekai iei goe.”
Nia dagi hai mee dabu gu hagahuaidu a Jesus i nia mee e logo.
Malaa, Pilate ga heeu labelaa gi Mee, “Goe hagalee helekai gi nia helekai digaula? Hagalongo gi nia hagahuaidu huogodoo digaula i di Goe!”
Jesus e noho hua dee muu, gei Pilate gu gologolo huoloo.
Nia Hagamiami Pasoobaa huogodoo, gei Pilate e nnoo mau e hai gi hagamehede dana dangada galabudi dela e hiihai ginai nia daangada.
Taane go Barabbas nogo galabudi madalia digau hai baahi ala ne daaligi nia daangada gii mmade i lodo nneebagi.
Digau dogologo ne dagabuli mai, ga daamada ga huuhuli a Pilate gi heia go dana hai dela nogo hai ang gi ginaadou.
Mee ga heeu, “Goodou e hiihai bolo au gi haga mehede ina adu di king o digau o Jew?”
Mee gu iloo humalia, bolo nia dagi hai mee dabu la ne wanga a Jesus gi deia, i di nadau dubua i Mee.
Gei nia dagi hai mee dabu ga huuhuli digau dogologo aalaa gi helekai gi Pilate gi hagamehede ina a Barabbas.
Pilate ga helekai labelaa gi digaula, “Malaa di aha dela e hiihai ginai goodou bolo au gi heia gi taane dela e hagaingoo go goodou bolo di king o digau o Jew?”
Gei digaula gaa wwolo, “Daudaulia a Mee!”
Pilate ga heeu, “Malaa, di huaidu aha, dela ne hai go Mee?” Gei digaula gaa wwolo labelaa gi nonua, “Daudaulia a Mee!”
Pilate e hiihai e haga manawa lamalia lodo digau dogologo aalaa, dela ga hagamehede a Barabbas gi digaula, nomuli geia gaa dugu ang gi digaula gi haga mamaawa dia Jesus, gi daudau ina a Mee.
Digau dauwa gaa lahi a Jesus gi lodo di abaaba di hale gobinaa, ga gahigahi mai nadau ihoo gau dauwa huogodoo.
Digaula ga haga ulu a Jesus gi di gahu mmee uli, gaa bini di nadau hau laagau duduia, gaa wanga gi di libogo o Maa.
Gei digaula gaa pala ga hagaaloho gi Mee ga helekai, “Di king o digau o Jew gi mouli waalooloo!”
Gei digaula ga haga mamaawa dono libogo gi di laagau, ga buibui nadau haawale gi Mee, ga dogoduli, ga palapala gi Mee.
Gaa lawa loo di nadau hagahuaidu a Mee, gaa daa gi daha di gahu mmee uli, ga haga ulu a Mee labelaa gi ono gahu donu, gaa dagi a Mee gi tua di waahale belee daudau gi di loobuu.
Digaula ga heetugi gi taane dono ingoo go Simon, tangada o Cyrene, tamana o Alexander mo Rufus. Mee ne haneia i tenua gi di waahale deelaa, gei digau dauwa gaa hai a mee gi aamo ina di loobuu a Jesus.
Digaula gaa lahi a Jesus gi di gowaa dela e haga ingoo bolo Golgotha, dela dono hadinga boloo, “Di Gowaa Hangaibu Libogo”.
Digaula ga hagamada gaa wanga nadau waini gu unugi gi nia ‘myrrh’, gei Jesus digi inu mia nia maa.
Gei digaula ga daudau a Mee, gaa duwwe nia gahu o Maa i ginaadou. Ga huduhudu nadau ‘dice’ belee halahala be dehee di mee gahu gaa kae ko ai.
Di laa e hiwa luada dela ne daudau iei Mee.
Di haga modongoohia taudau o Maa, guu hihi gi hongo di loobuu e hai boloo, “Di king o digau o Jew.”
Digaula gu daudau labelaa nia daane huaidu dogolua i baahi o Mee, e dahi i dono baahi gau donu, ge dahi i dono baahi gau ihala.
[Di Beebaa Dabu e hai donu i telekai deenei, “Mee guu dau dalia digau huaidu.”]
Nia daangada ma ga lloomoi laa laa, le e lialiagi nadau libogo mo di haganneennee a Jesus, ga helehelekai, “Hahaa! Ma kooe dela belee oho di Hale Daumaha, ga haga duu aga labelaa i lodo nia laangi e dolu!
Doo iha laa gi daha, heia Goe gi mouli!”
Nia dagi hai mee dabu, mo digau haga donudonu haganoho, e haganneennee labelaa a Jesus, ga helehelekai, “Mee e mee di haga mouli nia daangada, gei e deemee di haga mouli Ia!
Heia gimaadou gi gidee di Mesaia, di king o digau Israel, e doo iha gi lala mo di loobuu dolomeenei, gei gimaadou ga hagadonu laa Goe!” Nia daane ala ne daudau dalia a Mee e haganneennee labelaa a Jesus.
I di oodee, gei tenua hagatau gu bouli dongoeho, gaa dae loo gi di laa e dolu.
I di laa e dolu, gei Jesus gaa dangi gi nua, “Eloi, Eloi, Lama, Sabaktani?” dono hadinga boloo, “Dogu God, dogu God, Goe gu diiagi Au beleiaha?”
Hunu gau ala e tuu i golo gu longono, ga helekai, “Hagalongo, Mee e gahigahi a Elijah!”
Tangada i digaula gaa lele, gaa kae dana liimi, ga hagatiu gi lodo nia waini hui ngoohia, gaa dui gi di ngudu di laagau, gaa togo gi nia malau ngudu o Jesus, ga helekai, “Daalia, gii mmada gidaadou be Elijah e hanimoi e dugu ia a Mee!”
Jesus gaa dangi gi nua, ga hagaodi ono madangi.
Di gahu duuli nogo dau i lodo di Hale Daumaha, gu mahaa lua eia i nua, guu modu gi lala.
Tagi dauwa nogo duu i mua di loobuu, ne gidee ia di made o Jesus, ga helekai, “Taane deenei la go Tama donu a God.”
Nia ahina nogo i golo, e mmada mai i daha. Mary mai Magdala, mo Mary tinana o James dulii mo Joseph, mo Salome, nogo i baahi digaula.
Aanei go digaula nogo madalia a Jesus i Galilee, nogo hagamaamaa a Mee. Gei nia ahina dogologowaahee ala i golo, ne lloomoi labelaa dalia a Mee gi Jerusalem.
Hiahi ia di mee, gei Joseph tangada o Arimathea ga dau mai.
Mee tangada hagalabagau i lodo digau hai gabunga aamua, ge e talitali hogi Teenua King o God. Di laangi deelaa la di Laangi Hagatogomaalia, dela di laangi i mua di Laangi Sabad, malaa, Joseph gaa hana hagamahi gi mua o Pilate belee madau tuaidina o Jesus.
Pilate gu homouli huoloo i dana longono bolo Jesus la guu made, geia ga gahi mai tagi dauwa belee heeu be di maa e donu, bolo Jesus la guu made.
Dono modongoohia di made o Jesus mai tagi dauwa, gei mee ga hagi anga gi Joseph gi kae ina tuaidina o Jesus.
Joseph gaa hui dana gahu lenge, ga dugu ia tuaidina o Maa gi lala, gaa hii a Mee gi di gahu deelaa, gaa dugu gi lodo taalunga dela ne hodo gi lodo tadugalaa. Gaa lawa ga haga daga mai tadugalaa damana, gaa pono di bontai taalunga.
Mary mai Magdala, mo Mary tinana o Joseph nogo i golo, gu gidee di gowaa dela e dugu ai tuaidina o Jesus.
I muli di Laangi Sabad, Mary mai Magdala, mo Mary tinana o James, mo Salome gaa hui nadau lolo kala, belee hula e hagatulu tuaidina o Jesus.
Luada loo di laangi tabu, digaula gaa dau i taalunga i di madagoaa di laa e hobo,
ge heheeu i nadau mehanga, “Ma koai dela ga hagamaamaa gidaadou e hagadaga tadugalaa gi daha mo di bontai o taalunga?” Idimaa tadugalaa le e damanaiee.
Digaula ga mmada adu, gei di maa guu lawa di hagadaga gi daha.
Gei digaula ga ulu adu gi lodo taalunga, gaa mmada gi tama daane e ulu ono gahu kene hila mmaa, e noho i di baahi gau donu taalunga, gei digaula gu homouli gu mmaadagu.
Mee ga helekai, “Goodou hudee mmaadagu, au e iloo bolo goodou e halahala a Jesus o Nazareth dela ne daudau. Mee hagalee i ginei, gu mouli aga. Mmada, deenei di gowaa nogo dugu iei Mee.
Hula, haga iloo ina gi ana dama agoago mo Peter boloo, ‘Mee guu hana gi Galilee i godou mua, deelaa di gowaa e heetugi iai goodou gi Mee be ana helekai ala ne hai adu.’”
Digaula ga ulu mai gi daha mo taalunga, ga llele hua i lodo di nadau mmaadagu, digi leelee gi tei dangada.
[I muli di mouli aga o Jesus luada loo di laangi tabu, mee ne haga gida eia gi Mary mai Magdala matagidagi, di ahina a Mee ne hagabagi ono hagataalunga huaidu e hidu.
Mary gaa hana ga odi gi nia hoo o Jesus ala e manawa gee ge e tangitangi.
Gei digaula digi hagadonu a mee ne helekai bolo Jesus gu mouli aga, gei guu mmada gi Mee.
Nomuli hua, gei Jesus ga haga gida eia i nia ala geegee gi ana dama agoago dogolua, i nau hula gi di nau guongo i tua di waahale.
Meemaa ga lloomoi labelaa ga hagi anga gi nau ihoo aalaa, gei digaula hagalee hagadonu.
I di hagaodi nia mee huogodoo, Jesus ne haga gida gi nia dama agoago dilongoholu maa dahi, i di nadau madagoaa nogo miami. Ge Ia ga haga buhi gi digaula i digaula nadau hagadonu ai, ge e hagadonu ngadaa digau ala ne mmada gi de Ia ne mouli aga.
Mee ga helekai gi digaula, “Hula gi nia madagowaa huogodoo ala i henuailala, hagadele ina di Longo Humalia gii dau i nia daangada huogodoo.
Tangada dela ga hagadonu, ga babdais, geia gu hagamouli. Tangada ma ga de hagadonu, le e hudu gi daha.
Digau hagadonu le e wanga ginai di mogobuna gii mee ai di hagabagi nia hagataalunga huaidu i dogu ingoo. Digaula ga leelee i nia helekai henua gee.
Maa digaula ma ga dahi aga nia gihaa, ga inu nia poisin, la hagalee mmade. Digaula ma ga daahi nadau lima gi hongo digau magi, nia magi le e hili.”
Tagi Jesus i muli ana helekai gi digaula, gei Mee gaa lahi gi di langi, gaa noho i di baahi gau donu o God.
Gei nia dama agoago gaa hula, ga agoago i nia madagowaa huogodoo, gei Tagi le e madalia digaula, e hagamaaloo nia agoago digaula bolo e donu, mai i nadau mogobuna haga goboina ala e hai.]
Dogu ihoo hagaaloho Theophilus. Digau dogologo ne hagamahi e hihi nnelekai o nia mee ala gu kila aga i tadau baahi.
Digaula ne hihi nia mee ala gu modongoohia gidaadou mai i baahi ginaadou ala ne mmada gi nia mee aanei i taamada, gei gu agoago nia maa gi nia daangada.
Meenei Theophilus, dogu mmada gi humalia gi nia mee haga lligi huogodoo mai taamada, gei au gu maanadu bolo ma koia e humalia, maa au gaa hihi nnelekai haga modongoohia adu gi di goe i nia mee ala ne hai.
Au e hai di mee deenei, gi modongoohia e goe di tonu dogomaalia o nia mee huogodoo ala guu lawa dau iloo.
Di madagoaa Herod nogo king i Judea, tangada hai mee dabu i golo dono ingoo go Zechariah, tangada ni di hagabuulinga gau hai mee dabu a Abijah. Dono lodo go Elizabeth, tangada labelaa ni di madawaawa digau hai mee dabu.
Meemaa e mouli humalia i mua o God, e haga kila aga nia helekai mo nia haganoho huogodoo Dimaadua.
Meemaa nau dama ai, idimaa, Elizabeth di ahina e dee huwa, meemaa gu mmaadua.
Dahi laangi hua, Zechariah nogo hai ana hegau dabu i lodo di Hale Daumaha.
I di hagatau dela nogo daudali go digau hai mee dabu, mee ne hilihili belee dudu ana ‘incense’ i hongo di gowaa dudu tigidaumaha lolo kala, mee ga ulu gi lodo di Hale Daumaha Dimaadua.
Di hagabuulinga dangada i malaelae, e dalodalo i di madagoaa tigidaumaha ‘incense’ e dudu.
Tangada di langi Dimaadua ga haga gida eia gi Zechariah, e duu i di baahi gau donu, di gowaa dudu tigidaumaha.
Di madagoaa Zechariah ne gidee tangada di langi deelaa, geia gu homouli, gu madagu huoloo.
Gei tangada di langi ga helekai, “Zechariah, hudee madagu! Au dalodalo la guu kila i baahi o God. Doo lodo go Elizabeth ga haanau dana dama daane, gei goe wanga ina dono ingoo go John.
Goe ga tenetene ge noho i di aumaalia, gei digau dogologo ga tenetene gi di haanau o maa.
Mee ga aamua i mua o God. Mee hagalee hai gii tale gi nia waini be gi nia dagaao maaloo. Taamada mai di haanau o maa, mee gaa honu i di Hagataalunga Dabu.
Mee ga laha mai labelaa digau Israel dogologo gi Dimaadua, go di nadau God.
Mee gaa hana i mua o Mee, e maaloo gei e mahi be soukohp Elijah. Mee ga hagahumalia mehanga nia damana mo nadau dama, gaa huli digau de hagalongo gi di tonu, mee gaa hai nia daangada o Dimaadua gi togomaalia gi Mee.”
Zechariah ga helekai gi tangada di langi, “Dehee dagu hai e iloo bolo nia helekai aanei le e donu e kila aga i dogu baahi, gimaua mo dogu lodo la gu mmaadua?”
Tangada di langi ga helekai, “Au go Gabriel. Au e duu i mua nnadumada o God. Au ne hagau mai belee haga iloo adu di longo humalia deenei.
Gei goe dela hagalee hagadonu dagu haga iloo dela ga gila aga i di madagoaa hai donu. Idimaa goe digi hagadonu, gei goe ga deemee di leelee, gaa dae loo gi di laangi dela e gila aga dagu hagababa deenei adu gi di goe.”
Di madagoaa deelaa, gei digau dogologo e talitali Zechariah, e gologolo be mee e aha dela e duai mai i lodo.
Di madagoaa a mee ne ulu mai gi daha mo di Hale Daumaha, gei mee gu deemee di leelee. Digaula gu iloo hua bolo mee guu mmada gi di mee i lodo di Hale Daumaha. Gei mee e duu i mua digaula e aau ono lima bolo ia e helekai, gei mee gu deemee di helekai.
Di madagoaa ne lawa ana hegau i lodo di Hale Daumaha, gei Zechariah gaa hana gi dono guongo.
Muli mai hua, dono lodo go Elizabeth gu hai dama, gaa noho hua i lodo dono hale i nia malama e lima.
Mee ga helekai, “Deenei di hai o Dimaadua ne hagamaamaa au dolomeenei, i dono daa gi daha dogu haga langaadia i baahi nia daangada!”
Di madagoaa Elizabeth ne hai dama nia malama e ono, gei God ga hagau mai tangada di langi Gabriel gi tama waahale Nazareth i Galilee,
gi baahi tama ahina madammaa, dono ingoo go Mary, dela gu hagababa ang gi Joseph, tangada di madawaawa David.
Tangada di langi gaa hana gi baahi o mee, ga helekai, “Mary, di aumaalia gi madalia goe! Dimaadua e noho i do baahi gei e haga maluagina goe!”
Mary gu homouli gi nia helekai a maa, gei gu gologolo be nnadinga ana helekai le e hai bolo aha.
Tangada di langi ga helekai, “Mary, hudee madagu, idimaa, tumaalia o God guu honu i do baahi.
Goe ga hai dama, ga haanau tama daane, gei goe wanga ina dono ingoo go Jesus.
Mee ga aamua, ga haga ingoo bolo Tama ni di God Aamua Huoloo. Dimaadua go God ga haga menege aga a Mee gii hai di king be dono damana go David.
Mee gaa hai di king ni di hagadili o Jacob, gaa hana hua beelaa, gei dono henua king la hagalee haga odi!”
Mary ga helekai gi tangada di langi, “Nia mee aanei e mee di kila aga behee i dogu baahi, i di au di ahina hua e noho madammaa?”
Tangada di langi ga helekai, “Di Hagataalunga Dabu ga hanadu gi di goe, gei nia mahi o God Aamua Huoloo ga haga holi goe, deenei tadinga Tama dabuaahia ga haga ingoo bolo Tama a God.
Maanadu ina do dangada go Elizabeth, dela e dugu go nia daangada bolo di ahina e dee huwa, gei dolomeenei gei mee gu hai dama, guu ono (6) ono malama, gei mee di ahina gu madumadua.
Idimaa, deai di mee e deemee di hai go God ai!”
Mary ga helekai, “Au di hege ni Dimaadua. Heia au gii hai be au helekai.” Tangada di langi ga hagatanga gaa hana.
Muli hua nia mee aanei, gei Mary ga hagalimalima gaa hana gi tama waahale i tenua gonduu o Judea.
Mee ga ulu gi lodo di hale o Zechariah, ga hagaaloho gi Elizabeth.
Di madagoaa Elizabeth ne longono ia Mary e hai dana hagaaloho, gei di tama i lodo o mee gu ngalungalua. Gei Elizabeth guu honu i di Hagataalunga Dabu,
gaa wolo gi nua, “Mary, goe gu maluagina i baahi nia ahina huogodoo, ge gu maluagina go di Tama dela ga haanau kooe!
Di mee haga goboina deenei e aha dela e hai mai gi di au, tinana o dogu Dagi e hanimoi e haga hidihidi gi dogu baahi?
Do madagoaa ne hagaaloho mai, gei di tama dela i ogu lodo gu ngalungalua i dono tenetene.
E maluagina go di ahina dela e hagadonu bolo nia helekai Dimaadua ga kila aga i dono baahi!”
Mary ga helekai, “Dogu manawa e hagaamu Dimaadua.
Dogu mouli e tenetene gi God, dogu Dangada Hagamouli,
i Mee dela ne langahia dana hege dulii loo deenei! Dolomeenei gaa huli gi muli, nia daangada huogodoo ga haga hagaamu au,
mai i nia hagadilinga mee haga goboina ala ne hai go God Aamua mai gi di au. Dono ingoo koia e dabuaahia.
Mee e haga modongoohia dono dumaalia ang gi digau ala e hagalaamua Ia, di adu dangada nei mo di adu dangada nei.
Mee ne holo dono lima mogobuna gi daha, ga hagahuaidu nia hiihai digau huogodoo ala e hagamuamua.
Mee ne daa nia king ala e hagamuamua gi daha mo nadau lohongo, ga haga mmaanege aga digau lligi.
Mee ne haga maaluu digau ala e hiigai gi nia meegai humalia, ga hagau gi daha digau maluagina gii hula nadau mee e kae ai.
Mee e dadaahi dana hagababa ang gi tadau maadua mmaadua, ne hanimoi belee hagamaamaa dana hege go Israel.
Mee e langahia dono dumaalia ne hai ang gi Abraham mo ono hagadili huogodoo gaa hana hua beelaa.”
Mary nogo noho i baahi Elizabeth nia malama e dolu. Nomuli, gei mee gaa hana gi dono hale.
Guu dae mai di madagoaa Elizabeth e haanau ai, gei mee ga haanau dana dama daane.
Digau ala i baahi o mee mo ono gau gu longono tumaalia o Dimaadua ang gi mee, gei digaula huogodoo gu tenetene huoloo madalia a mee.
Nia laangi e walu i muli di haanau di tama, gei digaula ga lloomoi belee sirkumsais di tama, ge wanga di ingoo o maa bolo Zechariah, e haga ingoo gi dono damana.
Tinana o maa ga helekai gi digaula, “Deeai, di ingoo o maa go John.”
Digaula ga helekai gi mee, “E hai behee? John la hagalee di ingoo dahi dangada i lodo oo gau.”
Digaula ga aau nadau lima gi tamana o tama, dehee di ingoo dela e hiihai ginai eia e haga ingoo di tama.
Zechariah ga aau ono lima gi gaamai di lau beebaa, gaa hihi, “Di ingoo o maa go John.” Gei digaula huogodoo gu goboina huoloo.
Di madagoaa hua deelaa, gei Zechariah guu mee di leelee labelaa, geia ga daamada ga hagaamu a God.
Digau o di gowaa deelaa huogodoo gu uli nadau gai huoloo, gei nia longo o nia mee aanei guu dele gi nia madagowaa huogodoo i hongo tenua gonduu o Judea.
Digau huogodoo ala ne longono nia mee aanei gu hagabaubau mo di heheeu be di tama deenei la gaa hai dana aha? Idimaa, gu modongoohia bolo nia mogobuna o Dimaadua la gu i baahi di tama deenei.
Zechariah tamana o John guu honu i di Hagataalunga Dabu, ga hagi aga nnelekai a God:
“Gidaadou e hagaamu Dimaadua, di God o Israel! Mee gu hanimoi belee hagamaamaa ana dama, ge e haga dagaloaha digaula.
Mee ne dugu mai gi gidaadou Tangada Daa Hagamouli aamua o di hagadili David, go dana dangada hai hegau.
Mee gu hagababa ang gi ana soukohp dabuaahia namua,
bolo Ia gaa daa gidaadou gi daha mo tadau hagadaumee, mo nia mahi o digau ala e de hiihai mai gi gidaadou.
Mee gu helekai bolo Ia ga dumaalia ang gi tadau maadua mmaadua, ge e langahia dana hagababa dabu.
Mee guu hai dana hagamodu gi tadau damana go Abraham, gei gu hagababa bolo Ia e daa mai gidaadou gi daha mo tadau hagadaumee, ge e dumaalia mai gi gidaadou gi hai hegau ang gi de Ia i tee madagu,
<range>
bolo gi dabuaahia gidaadou, gei gii donu i ono mua i nia laangi huogodoo i di waalooloo o tadau mouli.
Goe go dagu dama ga haga ingoo bolo di soukohp ni God Aamua Huoloo, idimaa, goe gaa hana i mua Dimaadua, e hagatogomaalia dono ala,
bolo goe gi agoago gi ana daangada di hai dela e mouli ai digaula, mai tumaalia o nadau huaidu.
Tadau God le e manawa dumaalia ge e humalia. Mee e haga maalama gidaadou gi di maalama haga mouli.
E ina digau huogodoo ala e noho i lodo di malu bouli o di made gi di maalama mai di langi, e dagi gidaadou i lodo di ala o di aumaalia.”
Di tama deelaa guu tomo aga dono mouli mo dono hagataalunga. Geia e noho i lodo di anggowaa gaa dae loo gi dono haga gida ia gi digau Israel.
Di madagoaa deelaa, gei di king Caesar Augustus ne dugu dana haganoho bolo nia daangada huogodoo dono henua le e hihi nadau ingoo.
Deenei di hihi dangada matagidagi i di madagoaa Quirinius nogo hai di gobinaa o Syria.
Digau huogodoo gu haga mmaanege gi nadau gowaa donu, bolo gii hihi nadau ingoo.
Joseph, tangada di hagadili o David, gu hagatanga i di waahale Nazareth i Galilee, gaa hana gi Bethlehem, di waahale o David i lodo Judea,
bolo gii dau ia e hihi ngaadahi mo Mary dela belee lodo gineia. Mary gu hai dama i di madagoaa deelaa.
Di madagoaa meemaa e noho i Bethlehem, gei Mary guu dae gi dono madagoaa e haanau ai,
gei mee ga haanau dana dama daane madua, gaa hii a Mee gi di gahu hii dama, gaa dugu gi lodo di mee haangai manu, idimaa, di hale noho dangada la gu deeoo.
Digau hagaloohi siibi nogo hagaloohi nadau siibi i di boo i lodo henua.
Tangada di langi Dimaadua ga haga gida ia gi digaula, gei di maahina o Dimaadua ga ina digaula. Digaula gu uli nadau gai huoloo.
Gei tangada di langi ga helekai gi digaula, “Goodou hudee mmaadagu, au e gowadu gi goodou di Longo Humalia e haga tenetene ai digau huogodoo.
Idimaa, Tangada Hagamouli gu haanau adu gi goodou boo nei i lodo di waahale o David. Mee go Christ go Tagi!
Deenei dono haga modongoohia: Goodou ga gidee di tama dulii e hii gi di gahu hii dama e moe i lodo di mee haangai manu.”
Di madagoaa hua deelaa, digau di langi dogologowaahee ga lloomoi gi baahi tangada di langi deelaa, ga haga hagaamu a God, ga daahili:
“Hagaamuina God i di langi i nua loo, gei di aumaalia i henuailala ang gi digau ala e manawa lamalia ginai Mee!”
Di madagoaa digau di langi ne hagatanga, gaa hula gi di langi, gei digau hagaloohi siibi aalaa ga helehelekai i nadau mehanga, “Gidaadou gaa hula gi Bethlehem, gi gidee gidaadou di mee dela ne hai, dela ne hagi mai go Dimaadua.”
Digaula ga limalima gaa hula, ga gidee Mary mo Joseph, mo tama dulii e moe i lodo di mee haangai manu.
Digau hagaloohi siibi ne gidee ginaadou di tama dulii deelaa, gei digaula ga hagamodongoohia gi Joseph mo Mary nia helekai a tangada di langi ala ne hai ang gi ginaadou i di hai o tama dulii deelaa.
Digau huogodoo ala ne longono nia helekai digau hagaloohi siibi, la gu goboina huoloo.
Mary ga langahia nia mee huogodoo, ga mamaanadu hua i ono lodo.
Digau hagaloohi siibi gaa hula gi muli, e dadaahili hagaamu a God i nia mee huogodoo ala ne longono ginaadou, gei guu mmada ginai, guu kila be nnelekai tangada di langi ala ne helekai ai.
Muli nia laangi e walu, gei di tama gu sirkumsais, gei digaula gaa gahi di ingoo o Maa bolo Jesus, gii hai be di ingoo tangada di langi dela ne hagaingoo a Mee i mua, gei Mary digi hai dama.
I muli di nau haga madammaa be di hai Nnaganoho Moses, gei Joseph mo Mary gaa lahi di tama gi Jerusalem belee hagadabu ang gi Dimaadua,
gadoo be nnelekai ala ne hihi i lodo Nnaganoho Dimaadua, “Nia ulu mmaadua daane huogodoo le e hagadabu ang gi Dimaadua.”
Gei meemaa guu kae labelaa nau mee e tigidaumaha gii hai be di mee dela gu haganoho mai baahi Dimaadua, “Nia mwuroi e lua be nia damaa manu ‘pigeon’ e lua.”
Di madagoaa deelaa, gei taane dono ingoo go Simeon e noho i Jerusalem. Mee tangada hai mee donu, ge e hagalaamua a God, nogo talitali di haga mouli o Israel, gei di Hagataalunga Dabu gu i dono baahi.
Di Hagataalunga Dabu la gu haga donu gi mee bolo mee hagalee made i mua dono gidee ia di Mesaia dela ne hagababa go Dimaadua.
Go di Hagataalunga hua deelaa ne dagi a mee gi di Hale Daumaha. Di madagoaa tamana mo tinana o Jesus ne laha mai a Mee gi lodo di Hale Daumaha gii hai be nnelekai o Nnaganoho,
Simeon gaa daa di tama, ga daahi, ga danggee ang gi God boloo,
“Meenei Dimaadua, dolomeenei Goe gu daahi dau hagababa, gei Goe guu mee hua di dugu anga dau hege gii hana i di aumaalia.
Au guu mmada donu gi ogu golomada gi dau haga mouli,
dela gu hagatogomaalia Kooe i mua nia daangada huogodoo.
Di maalama e haga modongoohia do hiihai gi digau tuadimee, ge e gaamai do madamada gi au dama Israel.”
Tamana mo tinana o tama gu goboina i nia helekai a Simeon ala nogo helekai i Mee.
Simeon ga haga maluagina meemaa, ga helekai gi Mary, go tinana o Tama, “Tama deenei ne hilihili go God belee hagahuaidu gei e haga mouli digau dogologo o Israel. Mee gaa hai di haga modongoohia mai baahi o God dela ga helekai hai baahi ginai digau dogologo,
ga haga modongoohia aga nadau maanadu hagammuni. Di manawa gee le e hai gadoo be tulumanu dauwa ma ga daalo do hadu manawa.”
Soukohp ahina Anna, tama ahina a Phanuel, tangada di madawaawa Asher nogo i golo. Mee di ahina gu madumadua, ne hai dono lodo i lodo nia ngadau e hidu.
Muli di made dono lodo, gei mee nogo noho hua dono dina. Mee gu huowalu maa haa (84) ono ngadau, gei mee digi hagatanga gi daha mo di Hale Daumaha. Boo mo aa, e daumaha ang gi God, e noho hagaonge mo di hai dalodalo.
Di aawaa hua deelaa, gei mee gaa dau, ga danggee ang gi God, mo di helekai i di Tama ang gi digau huogodoo ala e tali gi God bolo gi haga mehede ina Jerusalem.
Meemaa gaa lawa loo i di nau hai nia hegau gii hai be Nnaganoho Dimaadua, meemaa gaa hula gi muli gi Galilee gi di nau guongo go Nazareth.
Di tama ne madua aga gu maaloo, guu honu i di kabemee, gei tumaalia dehuia a God gu madalia a Mee.
Nia ngadau huogodoo nia maadua Jesus e hulahula gi Tagamiami Pasoobaa i Jerusalem.
Jesus gu madangaholu maa lua ono ngadau, gei digaula gaa hula gi Tagamiami deelaa, be nadau hai nogo hulahula.
I muli Tagamiami ne lawa, gei digaula gaa hula gi nadau guongo, gei tama daane go Jesus guu noho hua i Jerusalem, gei nia maadua o Maa digi iloo.
Meemaa e hagabau bolo Mee i lodo digau dogologo ala e hula, gei meemaa gaa hula i di laangi dogomaalia, ga daamada ga halahala a Mee gi baahi nau gau mo nau ihoo.
Meemaa digi gidee a Mee, gaa hula gi muli gi Jerusalem, e halahala a Mee.
I muli nia laangi e dolu, meemaa ga gidee a Mee i lodo di Hale Daumaha, e noho i baahi digau agoago o Jew, e hagalongolongo gi nia helekai digaula mo di heheeu ana mee.
Digau huogodoo ne longono nia helekai kabemee a Maa ne helekai gi nia heeu digaula, digaula gu goboina huoloo.
Nia maadua o Maa gu goboina di nau gidee a Mee, gei tinana o Maa ga helekai, “Dagu dama daane, ma di aha ne hai Kooe? Gimaua gu uli mau gai i di mau halahala Goe!”
Jesus ga helekai, “Goolua e halahala Au eiaha? Goolua e de iloo bolo Au belee hai loo gii noho i lodo di hale o dogu Damana?”
Meemaa digi modongoohia nnelekai a Maa.
Jesus gaa hana i muli meemaa gi Nazareth, di gowaa nogo hagalongo iei Mee gi meemaa. Tinana o Maa e daahi hagahumalia nia mee huogodoo aanei i ono lodo.
Jesus gu tomo aga dono huaidina mo dono iloo mee, gu hiihai ginai a God mo nia daangada.
Di madangaholu maa lima ngadau o Caesar Tiberius nogo dagi, Pontius Pilate nogo gobinaa i Judea, gei Herod nogo dagi Galilee, dono duaahina go Philip nogo dagi Iturea mo Trachonitis, Lysanias nogo dagi a Abilene,
gei Annas mo Caiaphas la nia dagi aamua hai mee dabu. Deenei di madagoaa nia helekai a God ne dau i John, go tama Zechariah, i lodo di anggowaa.
Gei John gaa hana laa lodo di guongo dela iai di monowai Jordan, ga agoago, “Huli gi daha mo godou haihai huaidu ge gi babdais, gei God ga dumaalia adu gi godou huaidu!”
Gadoo be di mee dela guu hihi i lodo di beebaa soukohp Isaiah, “Tangada e wolowolo i lodo di anggowaa, boloo, ‘Haga adee ina di ala o Dimaadua gi togomaalia, haga huudonu ina di ala e hana iei Mee.
Nia gowaa bogobogo la gi haawa gii honu, nia gonduu llauehe mono gonduu lligi la gi hagabapaba ina. Nia ala pigapiga la gi haga huudonu ina, gei nia ala dungadungaa gi heia gi malallali.
Nia daangada huogodoo ga gidee di Hagamouli a God!’”
Nia daangada dogologo ne lloomoi gi John belee babdais. Gei mee ga helekai, “Goodou e hai be nia gihaa! Ma koai ne helekai bolo goodou e mee di llele gi daha mo di hagawelewele o God dela ga dau mai?
Heia nia mee ala e haga modongoohia bolo goodou guu huli gi daha mo godou huaidu, gei hudee daamada e helehelekai boloo, ‘Tadau damana la go Abraham.’ Au e hagi adu gi goodou bolo God le e mee hua di huli nia hadugalaa aanei gii hai nia dama ni Abraham!
Talai gu togomaalia belee hele gi daha nia laagau ala hagalee huwa humalia, e dudu.”
Nia daangada ga heeu gi John, “Gimaadou gaa hai di madau aha?”
Gei mee ga helekai, “Be koai hua e lua ono gahu, geia gi wanga ina di gahu e dahi gi tangada dela dono gahu ai. Koai ana meegai i golo, geia gi haga loholoho ngaadahi gi digau ala e hiigai.”
Hunu gau hagabudu dagitedi ne lloomoi belee babdais, ga heeu gi mee, “Tangada agoago, gimaadou e hai di madau aha?”
Mee ga helekai, “Hudee hagabudu mee laa hongo godou mee ala e donu belee hagabudu.”
Hunu gau dauwa ga heeu gi mee, “Gei gimaadou e hai di madau aha?” Mee ga helekai, “Hudee kaina nia bahihadu nia daangada, be e hagahuaidu tangada i di kai tilikai. Gii dohu hua gi godou hui donu.”
Nia daangada gu iai nadau hagadagadagagee e hidihidi be John la go di Mesaia.
Gei John ga helekai gi digaula huogodoo, “Au e babdais goodou gi nia wai, gei Tangada dela koia e aamua i di au, le e hanimoi i golo. Au e dee tau loo bolo e wwede nia uga o nia suudi o maa. Mee ga babdais goodou gi di Hagataalunga Dabu mo di ahi.
Mee dana daawolo hili mee, e wanga nia lii palaawaa gi lodo di hale benebene mee, gei nia gili gaa kili gi lodo di ahi e deemee di made.”
Nia ala kai e logo nogo agoago ai a John gi nia daangada i di Longo Humalia bolo gii huli nadau hangahaihai.
John nogo helekai hai baahi gi gobinaa Herod, idimaa Herod ne hai dono lodo gi Herodias, di lodo dono duaahina daane, guu hai labelaa ana mee huaidu e logo.
Gei Herod gaa hai dana hai koia e huaidu, gaa hudu a John gi lodo di hale galabudi.
Muli hua nia daangada huogodoo ne babdais go John, gei Jesus gu babdais labelaa. Dono madagoaa nogo dalodalo, gei di langi gu mahuge,
di Hagataalunga Dabu ga haneia gi hongo o Mee, e dina gi di mwuroi. Gei di lee ga haneia i di langi, “Goe go dagu Dama donu hagalabagau. Au e manawa lamalia adu gi di Goe.”
Di madagoaa Jesus ne daamada ana hegau, gei mee gu motolu ono ngadau. Nia daangada e hai bolo Mee tama ni Joseph, go tama daane Heli,
Heli go tama daane a Matthat, Matthat go tama daane Levi, Levi go tama daane a Melchi, Melchi go tama daane a Jannai, Jannai go tama daane a Joseph,
Joseph go tama daane a Mattathias, Mattathias go tama daane a Amos, Amos go tama daane Nahum, Nahum go tama daane a Esli, Esli go tama daane a Naggai,
Naggai go tama daane a Maath, Maath go tama daane a Mattathias, Mattathias go tama daane a Semein, Semein go tama daane a Sosek, Sosek go tama daane a Soda,
Soda go tama daane a Joanan, Joanan go tama daane a Rhesa, Rhesa go tama daane a Zerubbabel, Zerubbabel go tama daane a Shealtiel, Shealtiel go tama daane a Neri,
Neri go tama daane a Melchi, Melchi go tama daane a Addi, Addi go tama daane a Cosam, Cosam go tama daane a Elmadam, Elmadam go tama daane a Er,
Er go tama daane a Joshua, Joshua go tama daane a Eliezer, Eliezer go tama daane a Jorim, Jorim go tama daane a Matthat, Matthat go tama daane a Levi,
Levi go tama daane a Simeon, Simeon go tama daane a Judah, Judah go tama daane a Joseph, Joseph go tama daane a Jonam, Jonam go tama daane a Eliakim,
Eliakim go tama daane a Melea, Melea go tama daane a Menna, Menna go tama daane a Mattatha, Mattatha go tama daane a Nathan, Nathan go tama daane a David,
David go tama daane a Jesse, Jesse go tama daane a Obed, Obed go tama daane a Boaz, Boaz go tama daane a Salmon, Salmon go tama daane a Nahshon,
Nahshon go tama daane a Amminadab, Amminadab go tama daane a Admin, Admin go tama daane a Arni, Arni go tama daane a Hezron, Hezron go tama daane a Perez, Perez go tama daane a Judah,
Judah go tama daane a Jacob, Jacob go tama daane a Isaac, Isaac go tama daane a Abraham, Abraham go tama daane a Terah, Terah go tama daane a Nahor,
Nahor go tama daane a Serug, Serug go tama daane a Reu, Reu go tama daane a Peleg, Peleg go tama daane a Eber, Eber go tama daane a Shelah,
Shelah go tama daane a Cainan, Cainan go tama daane a Arphaxad, Arphaxad go tama daane a Shem, Shem go tama daane a Noah, Noah go tama daane a Lamech,
Lamech go tama daane a Methuselah, Methuselah go tama daane a Enoch, Enoch go tama daane a Jared, Jared go tama daane a Mahalaleel, Mahalaleel go tama daane a Cainan,
Cainan go tama daane a Enosh, Enosh go tama daane a Seth, Seth go tama daane a Adam, Adam go tama daane a God.
Jesus ga hagatanga i Jordan, geia guu honu i di Hagataalunga Dabu dela ne lahi a Mee gi lodo di anggowaa.
Gei Mee gaa noho i lodo di anggowaa i nia laangi e madahaa, ga hagamada go Setan. I lodo nia laangi aalaa, gei Mee digi miami, gu hiigai huoloo.
Setan ga helekai gi Mee, “Maa Goe di Tama ni God, helekai gi di hadugalaa deenei gii hai di palaawaa.”
Jesus ga helekai, “Ma guu lawa di hihi i lodo di Beebaa Dabu boloo, ‘Ma hagalee go nia palaawaa la hua ala e mee di haga mouli tangada.’”
Setan gaa lahi labelaa a Mee gi di gowaa nnoonua, ga haga mmada a Mee gi nia henua huogodoo i henuailala i tama madagoaa bodobodo,
ga helekai gi mee, “Au ga gowadu gi di Goe nia mogobuna mahi huogodoo aanei mo nia maluagina huogodoo. Huogodoo gu dugu mai gi di au, gei au e mee hua di wanga nia maa gi tangada dela e hiihai ginai au.
Nia mee aanei huogodoo ga gowadu gi di Goe, maa Goe ga daumaha mai.”
Jesus ga helekai, “Ma guu lawa di hihi i lodo di Beebaa Dabu boloo, ‘Daumaha ang gi Dimaadua go doo God, go Mee hua dela e hai hegau ginai goe!’”
Setan gaa lahi labelaa a Mee gi Jerusalem, gaa dugu a Mee gi hongo tahuhu o di Hale Daumaha, ga helekai gi Mee, “Maa goe di Tama ni God, hobo ia gi daha mo di gowaa deenaa.
Idimaa, ma guu lawa di hihi i lodo di Beebaa Dabu boloo, ‘God ga helekai gi ana gau di langi gi benabena ina Goe gi humalia.’
“Guu hai labelaa boloo, ‘Digaula gaa kumi laa Goe gi dee tale oo wae gi nia hadu.’”
Jesus ga helekai, “Ma guu lawa di hihi boloo, ‘Goe hudee hagamada ina Dimaadua, go doo God.’”
Di madagoaa Setan ne lawa di hagamadamada Jesus, gei mee ga hagatanga gi daha mo Mee i tama madagoaa bodobodo.
Jesus gu maaloo mai i di Hagataalunga Dabu, ge Ia gaa hana gi muli gi Galilee. Dono longo guu dele i nia madagowaa huogodoo ala i golo.
Gei Mee e hai ana agoago i lodo nia synagogee digaula, huogodoo gu haga hagaamu a Mee.
Jesus gaa hana gi Nazareth, di gowaa dela ne tomo aga ieia, ga ulu gi lodo synagogee i di Laangi Sabad be dana hai nogo haihai. Gei Mee ga duu aga belee dau dana Beebaa Dabu.
Gei digaula ga gaamai di beebaa soukohp Isaiah gi Mee, ge Ia gaa huge di beebaa deelaa, gaa dau di gowaa dela e hihi boloo,
“Di Hagataalunga o Dimaadua la gu i dogu baahi. Mee gu hagatulu Au gi agoago ina di Longo Humalia ang gi digau hagaloale. Mee ne hagau mai Au gi hagadele ina gi digau ala e lawalawa gi maahede, mo digau ala e dee gida gi gidee, gi haga maahede ina digau ala e noho i lodo di haingadaa,
gi hagadele ina bolo di madagoaa gu dae mai, go di madagoaa Dimaadua e haga dagaloaha ana daangada.”
Jesus gaa wini di beebaa deelaa, gaa wanga gi tangada hai hegau, gaa noho gi hongo dono lohongo. Huogodoo ala i lodo synagogee, e daumada a Mee,
gei Mee ga daamada ga helekai, “Digau nei, dangi nei nia helekai di Beebaa Dabu ala gu longono goodou, la gu kila aga i tadau baahi!”
Digaula huogodoo guu tene gi Mee huoloo, gei gu goboina i nia helekai humalia aalaa, ala ne loomoi i baahi o Mee. Digaula ga helekai, “Mee hagalee go tama daane Joseph?”
Jesus ga helekai gi digaula, “Au e iloo bolo goodou ga helekai nia helekai podo mai gi di Au boloo, ‘Togidaa, hagahili ina goe!’ Gei goodou ga helekai mai labelaa boloo, ‘Gi heia i lodo do guongo donu nia mee haga goboina ala ne longono ai gimaadou bolo ne hai Kooe i Capernaum.’”
Gei Mee ga duudagi adu hua, ga helekai, “Goodou gi iloo, bolo ma soukohp e hagalabagau i lodo dono guongo donu ai.
“E donu bolo nia ahina guu mmade nadau lodo e dogologowaahee i Israel i di madagoaa soukohp Elijah, i di madagoaa di uwa digi doo i lodo nia ngadau e dolu mo di baahi, mo tau magamaga damana guu gahu tenua deelaa.
Gei Elijah digi hagau ina gi dahi dangada i lodo Israel, gei ne hagau hua gi di ahina tuadimee gu made dono lodo dela e noho i Zarephath i lodo tenua go Sidon.
Gadoo be di madagoaa soukohp Elisha, nogo iai di magi genegene i Israel, gei deai tangada i digaula ne hili ga madammaa ai, dela hua go Naaman, tangada o Syria.”
Digau huogodoo nogo i lodo synagogee gu hagawelewele huoloo i di nadau longono nia helekai aanei.
Digaula gaa lahi a Jesus gi daha mo di waahale gi tomo di gonduu dela ne hau ai di nadau waahale, belee bale a Mee gii doo gi di gowaa helemodu.
Gei Jesus gaa hana laa lodo digaula, gaa hana gi daha mo digaula.
Nomuli, Jesus gaa hana gi Capernaum, di waahale i Galilee, ga agoago gi nia daangada i di Laangi Sabad.
Nia daangada huogodoo gu goboina i nia agoago a Maa, i Mee e agoago i di mogobuna.
Taane i lodo synagogee, iai di hagataalunga huaidu i ono lodo, mee gaa wolo gi nua,
“Jesus o Nazareth, ma di aha e hiihai ginai Goe i gimaadou? Goe ne hanimoi belee hagahuaidu gimaadou? Aahaa, au e iloo eau Goe tangada dabuaahia kae hegau a God!”
Jesus ga hagabuhi gi di hagataalunga huaidu, “Noho dee muu, ulu mai gi daha mo taane deenaa!” Gei di hagataalunga huaidu ga hagahinga taane gi lala i mua digaula, ga ulu gi daha mo mee ge digi hai dana huaidu gi mee.
Nia daangada huogodoo gu goboina ga helehelekai, “Ma nia helekai aha aanei? Mee e mogobuna di helekai gi nia hagataalunga huaidu, gei digaula e ulu mai gi daha!”
Di longo o Jesus guu dele i nia madagowaa huogodoo i lodo tenua deelaa.
Jesus ga hagatanga gi daha mo synagogee, gaa hana gi di hale o Simon. Tinana di lodo Simon e magi welengina huoloo. Digaula ga helekai gi Jesus i di ahina deelaa.
Jesus ga menege adu gi mee, ga helekai gi di magi welengina gi ulu mai gi daha. Di magi welengina gu ulu mai gi daha, mee ga ala aga, ga nnoo i nua, ga hagamaamaa digaula.
Hiahi ia di mee, digau huogodoo ala nadau ihoo magi i nia hagadilinga magi e logo, ga laha mai digaula gi Jesus. Mee gaa dugu ono lima gi hongo digaula huogodoo, e hagadau dagidahi, ga hagahili digaula.
Nia hagataalunga huaidu ala e ulu gi daha mo digau dogologo e wwolowwolo, “Goe go Tama a God!” Jesus gu bule digaula, digi dumaalia gi digaula gi helekai, i digaula gu iloo bolo Mee go di Mesaia.
Hooaga haga luada loo, Jesus gaa hana gi daha mo di waahale gi di gowaa lomo modogoia. Gei nia daangada ga daamada ga halahala a Mee, ga gidee a Mee, ga tangi gi Mee bolo gi hudee hagatanga gi daha mo ginaadou.
Mee ga helekai gi digaula, “Au e hai loo gi agoago di Longo Humalia o Teenua King o God gi nia waahale labelaa ala i golo, idimaa, deelaa di mee a God ne hagau mai ginai Au belee hai.”
Mee ga agoago i lodo nia synagogee i lodo tenua hagatau deelaa.
Dahi laangi hua Jesus nogo duu i taalinga Tai Gennesaret, nia daangada nogo honohono ginaadou i nadau lloo adu gi Jesus belee hagalongo gi nia helekai a God.
Mee ga gidee nia boodi e lua e haga pale aga i tongotai. Digau hai iga guu hula gu gaugau nadau kau.
Jesus gaa gaga gi hongo di boodi a Simon, ga helekai gi mee gi hologia dulii gi daha mo tongotai. Jesus gaa noho i hongo di boodi, ga agoago gi digau dogologo aalaa.
Mee ga haga lawa ana agoago, ga helekai gi Simon, “Hologia di boodi gi di gowaa honu, dugu ina gi lala nia kau gubenge.”
Simon ga helekai, “Meenei Tagi, gimaua gu gubenge mai loo boo, gu duadua, gei digi kumi mau iga. Gei Goe bolo gi dugua nia kau, au gaa dugu laa nia kau.”
Meemaa gaa dugu nia kau gi lala, gu bulou nau iga logowaahee. Nia kau la bolo ga mahaahaa.
Gei meemaa ga lialiagi gi di nau ihoo boodi gi lloomoi e hagamaamaa ginaua. Digaula ga lloomoi, gaa haa nadau boodi e lua gu hontula bolo ga abulu.
Simon Peter ne mmada gi nia mee ala ne hai beenei, gei mee ga dogoduli gi lala i mua o Jesus, ga helekai, “Meenei Tagi, hana gi daha mo au! Au tangada huaidu!”
Mee mo ono ehoo gu goboina tagabae iga ala ne kumi go ginaadou.
Nia hoo Simon, James mo John go nia dama daane Zebedee, la gu goboina labelaa ginaua. Jesus ga helekai gi Simon, “Goe hudee madagu, tugi dolomeenei gaa hana, gei goe ga haangodo gi nia daangada.”
Digaula ga hudi aga nia boodi gi tongotai, ga diiagi nia mee huogodoo, ga daudali a Jesus.
Nomuli, gei Jesus nogo i lodo di waahale dela nogo iai taane e hai dono magi genegene. Taane deelaa ne mmada gi Jesus, ga bala gi lala ga dangidangi, “Meenei, maa Goe e hiihai, heia au gi madammaa!”
Jesus ga hagadau dae adu, gaa bili gi mee, ga helekai, “Uaa, Au e hiihai. Madammaa!” Di madagoaa hua deelaa, gei di magi genegene guu hili.
Jesus gaa bule gi mee, “Hudee hagi anga ina di mee deenei gi tei dangada, hana haga huudonu gi tangada hai mee dabu, gi haga dina ina goe, gaa lawa, heia dau tigidaumaha dela gu haganoho go Moses, bolo e hai di haga modongoohia gi digaula bolo goe gu madammaa.”
Di longo o Jesus guu dele labelaa koia gi nonua, gu modoho gi daha, gei digau dogologo ne loomoi belee hagalongo gi Mee, ge e hagahili nadau magi.
Gei Mee gaa hana gi di gowaa lomo e dalodalo.
Dahi laangi hua, Jesus nogo agoago, gei nia Pharisee mono gau haga donudonu haganoho e noho i golo. Digaula ne lloomoi mai nia waahale huogodoo Galilee, Judea, mo mai Jerusalem. Di mogobuna o Dimaadua gu i baahi o Jesus e hagahili nia magi.
Hunu daane ne lloomoi e aamo mai di nadau daane mmade ono wae i hongo di hada. Digaula e hagamahi belee laha mai taane deenei gi mua o Jesus i lodo di hale.
Idimaa gu dogologowaahee, gu deeoo di lahi a mee gi lodo, gei digaula gaa lahi a mee gi tuatala o di hale, ga haga bongoo di gowaa e haga hege ia a mee i hongo dono moenge gi lodo digau dogologo i mua o Jesus.
Jesus ga gidee Ia nia hagadonu digaula, Mee ga helekai gi taane deelaa, “Dogu ihoo hagaaloho, o huaidu gu maahede.”
Digau hagadonudonu haganoho mo nia Pharisee ga daamada ga helehelekai i nadau mehanga, “Taane deenei la koai, dela e helekai hai baahi gi God? Tangada e mee di wwede nia huaidu ai, dela hua go God modogoia!”
Jesus gu iloo nia maanadu digaula, ga helekai, “Goodou e aha ala e hagabaubau beenaa?
Dehee di mee e haingoohia belee helekai boloo, ‘O huaidu la gu maahede,’ be e helekai boloo, ‘Duu i nua, haele?’
Au ga haga modongoohia adu gi goodou bolo Tama Tangada le e mogobuna i henuailala, e mee di wwede nia huaidu.” Gei mee ga helekai gi tangada mmade ono wae, “Au e helekai adu gi duu i nua, dahi aga ina do moenge, hana gi doo hale.”
Di madagoaa hua deelaa, gei taane ga duu i nua i mua digaula huogodoo, ga dahi aga dono moenge, gaa hana gi dono hale mo di hagaamu a God.
Digaula gu goboina, gu mmaadagu, gu hagaamu a God, ga helekai, “Gidaadou guu mmada gi nia mee haga goboina dangi nei!”
Muli di mee deenei, Jesus gaa hana ga gidee ia tangada hagabudu dagitedi go Levi, e noho i lodo dono oobidi. Jesus ga helekai, “Daudalia mai Au.”
Levi ga du gi nua ga diiagi ana mee huogodoo, ga daudali a Mee.
Levi guu hai dana hagamiami damana i dono hale gi Jesus, digau hagabudu dagitedi mono daangada labelaa nogo i baahi digau dogologo aalaa.
Hunu Pharisee mono gau haga donudonu haganoho o nadau buini, e helekai haga de hiihai gi nia dama agoago a Jesus boloo, “Ma e aha dela goodou e miami ge e inu i baahi digau hagabudu dagitedi mono balu daangada?”
Jesus ga helekai gi digaula, “Digau ala hagalee magi la hagalee halahala togidaa, go digau magi hua.
Au hagalee ne hanimoi belee gahigahi digau ala e donu, gei ne hanimoi gi digau ala huaidu, gi daahuli nadau lodo.”
Hunu gau ne helekai gi Jesus, “Nia dama agoago John nogo noho hagaonge i nia madagoaa e logo ge e hai dalodalo. Nia dama agoago nia Pharisee nogo hai labelaa beelaa, gei au dama agoago e miami ge e inu.”
Jesus ga helekai, “Goodou e hagamaanadu bolo goodou e mee di hai digau tagamiami haga hai lodo gii noho hagaonge i di madagoaa taane hai lodo la i baahi digaula? E deemee di hai beelaa!
Gei di madagoaa i golo, taane hai lodo la gaa lahi gi daha mo digaula, gei digaula gaa noho laa hagaonge.”
Jesus ga helekai labelaa gi digaula di ala kai deenei, “Deai tangada e haahi dana mee gahu i di gahu hoou e pono di gahu bobo ai. Maa gaa hai beelaa, gei mee ga haga mahaa di gahu hoou, gei di mee gahu hoou la hagalee tongaadahi gi di mee gahu bobo.
“Deai tangada hogi e hagahau ana waini hoou gi lodo nia mee dugu waini pobo ai, idimaa, nia waini hoou la ga hahaahi nia mee dugu waini pobo, gei nia waini la ga mmaalingi, gei nia mee dugu waini la ga mooho.
Gei deeai, nia waini hoou le e hai gi hagahau gi lodo nia mee dugu waini hoou.
Tangada e hiihai gi nia waini hoou ai i muli dono inu nia waini gu duai. Mee ga helekai bolo nia waini ala gu duai la koia e kala.”
Jesus nogo hana i lodo nia gowaa dogi laagau ‘wheat’ i di Laangi Sabad. Nia dama agoago a Maa ga daamada gaa hagi nadau huwa laagau ‘wheat’, ga milimili i lodo nadau lima, gaa gai nia lii nia maa.
Hunu Pharisee ga helekai, “Goodou e aha ala e hai nia mee ala guu bule go tadau haganoho bolo hagalee hai i di Laangi Sabad?”
Jesus ga helekai gi digaula, “Goodou digi daulia di mee a David ne hai i tolongo o mee mo ono ehoo ne hiigai?
Mee ne hana gi lodo di Hale o God, gaa kae nia palaawaa ala gu hagadabu gi God, gaa gai, gaa wanga gi ono ehoo. Gei di maa e hai baahi gi tadau haganoho ma gaa gai nia maa, ala hua go digau hai mee dabu.”
Jesus ga helekai, “Tama Tangada la go di Tagi o di Laangi Sabad.”
Di Laangi Sabad nomuli, gei Jesus ga ulu gi lodo synagogee, ga agoago, gei di maa taane i golo guu made dono lima gau donu.
Digau haga donudonu haganoho mono Pharisee e golomada a Mee be Mee e hagahili ana magi i di Laangi Sabad, gei digaula guu mee hua di hagahuaidu a Mee ga hai baahi gi Mee.
Gei Jesus gu iloo Ia nia maanadu digaula, ga helekai gi taane deelaa, “Duu i nua, duu mai gi mua.” Gei mee ga duu aga gaa duu gi mua digaula.
Gei Jesus ga helekai gi digaula, “Au e heeu adu gi goodou: Ma ni aha ala e dugu mai go tadau haganoho bolo gi heia i di Laangi Sabad? E hagamaamaa be e hagahuaidu? E benebene di mouli tangada, be e daaligi di mouli?”
Mee gaa mmada gi digaula huogodoo, ga helekai gi taane deelaa, “Holohia doo lima gi daha.” Gei mee gaa holo dono lima, gei guu hili.
Gei digaula gu hagawelewele, gu helehelekai i nadau mehanga be dehee di nadau hai gaa hai gi Jesus.
Muli mai hua, gei Jesus gaa hana gi tomo di gonduu belee dalodalo, guu noho i golo i di boo deelaa, e hai ana dalodalo ang gi God.
Dono luada, gei Mee ga gahigahi mai ana dama agoago, ga hilihili ana gau dilongoholu maa lua, ga haga ingoo bolo digau agoago hagau:
Simon (dela e haga ingoo labelaa go Mee bolo Peter) mo dono duaahina go Andrew, James mo John, Philip mo Bartholomew,
